terms.short_definition: Allowing thoughts, feelings or situations to be as they are, instead of fighting them, when they cannot be changed right now.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagpapahintulot sa isip, damdamin o sitwasyon na maging ganoon, sa halip na labanan, kapag hindi pa ito mababago ngayon.
terms.detailed_definition: Acceptance is not giving up or approving of something. It frees energy for what you can change. It is a key part of several therapies, including Acceptance and Commitment Therapy and DBT.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi pagsuko o pagsang-ayon ang pagtanggap. Pinalalaya nito ang lakas para sa kaya mong baguhin. Mahalagang bahagi ito ng ilang therapy, kabilang ang Acceptance and Commitment Therapy at DBT.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Letting it be what it is, for now.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Hinahayaan itong maging ganoon, sa ngayon.
examples: Accepting that you feel nervous before a speech, and speaking anyway.
Tinanggap mong kinakabahan ka bago magsalita, at nagsalita ka pa rin.
questions: What would change if you stopped fighting this feeling?
Ano ang magbabago kung titigil kang labanan ang damdaming ito?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: The sense that you can make choices and take actions that affect your life.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang pakiramdam na kaya mong pumili at kumilos para sa iyong buhay.
terms.detailed_definition: Agency is the contrasting concept to helplessness. It can be rebuilt through small, achievable actions.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ito ang kabaligtaran ng kawalan ng magagawa. Muling napapalakas ito sa pamamagitan ng maliliit at kayang gawing hakbang.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling like your choices still count.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na may saysay pa rin ang mga pinipili mo.
examples: Choosing to walk for ten minutes and noticing that you made something happen.
Pinili mong maglakad nang sampung minuto at napansin mong may nagawa ka.
questions: What is one small choice you made today?
Ano ang isang maliit na pinili mo ngayong araw?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

terms.short_definition: Having mixed or opposite feelings about the same thing at the same time.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagkakaroon ng magkahalo o magkasalungat na damdamin tungkol sa iisang bagay nang sabay.
terms.detailed_definition: Ambivalence is normal, especially around big changes like moving, graduating or ending a relationship. Naming both sides can make decisions clearer.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Normal ang halo-halong damdamin, lalo na sa malalaking pagbabago gaya ng paglipat, pagtatapos o paghihiwalay. Ang pagpapangalan sa dalawang panig ay nakalilinaw ng pasya.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling two ways about one thing.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Dalawang pakiramdam sa iisang bagay.
examples: Being happy to graduate and sad to leave your friends.
Masaya kang magtatapos pero malungkot na iiwan ang mga kaibigan.
questions: What are the two sides you feel?
Ano ang dalawang panig na nararamdaman mo?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

terms.short_definition: A strong feeling of displeasure, often in response to being wronged, blocked or threatened.
terms.short_definition_fil: Matinding pakiramdam ng inis o poot, kadalasang dahil sa pagkakamali ng iba, pagkahadlang o banta.
terms.detailed_definition: Anger is a normal emotion that can signal that a boundary or value has been crossed. How it is expressed matters more than whether it is felt.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Normal na damdamin ang galit; maaaring senyales ito na may hangganan o pinahahalagahang nalampasan. Mas mahalaga kung paano ito ipinapahayag kaysa kung nararamdaman ito.
terms.in_simpler_terms: The heat you feel when something seems unfair or wrong.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang init na nararamdaman mo kapag may tila hindi patas o mali.
examples: Feeling your face heat up when someone takes credit for your work.
Uminit ang mukha mo nang angkinin ng iba ang ginawa mo.
questions: What do you think the anger is protecting?
Ano sa tingin mo ang pinoprotektahan ng galit na ito?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
Language and organisation of Filipino emotion concepts: Comparing emotion concepts and dimensions across cultures
Church, A. T., Katigbak, M. S., Reyes, J. A. S., & Jensen, S. M. (1998). Cognition and Emotion, 12(1), 63–92
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

terms.short_definition: A reduced ability to feel pleasure or interest in activities that used to be enjoyable.
terms.short_definition_fil: Paghina ng kakayahang makaramdam ng saya o interes sa mga gawaing dating kinagigiliwan.
terms.detailed_definition: Anhedonia is a clinical term used by professionals; it is one feature they look for when assessing depression and other conditions. Only a professional can assess it.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Klinikal na termino ang anhedonia na ginagamit ng mga propesyonal; isa ito sa mga tinitingnan nila sa pagsusuri ng depresyon at iba pang kondisyon. Propesyonal lamang ang makapagsusuri nito.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Things that used to feel good now feel flat.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang mga bagay na dating nagpapasaya ay parang wala nang lasa.
questions: Have activities you used to enjoy started to feel flat for a long while?
Matagal na bang parang walang lasa ang mga gawaing dati mong kinagigiliwan?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
Treadway, M. T., & Zald, D. H. (2011). Neuroscience & Biobehavioral Reviews, 35(3), 537–555
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association
cues: Losing pleasure in things is what this clinical term describes — a professional can help make sense of it.
Losing interest in things you used to enjoy is related to this concept.
Not enjoying things anymore relates to this concept.

terms.short_definition: A feeling of unease, worry or fear about something that might happen, often with tension in the body.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam ng kaba, pag-aalala o takot sa maaaring mangyari, kadalasang may tensyon sa katawan.
terms.detailed_definition: Anxiety is a normal response to uncertainty or threat. It becomes a concern when it is intense, lasts a long time, or gets in the way of daily life. Anxiety disorders are clinical conditions that only a professional can assess.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Normal na tugon ang pagkabalisa sa kawalang-katiyakan o banta. Nagiging alalahanin ito kapag matindi, matagal, o nakaaabala na sa araw-araw. Ang mga anxiety disorder ay klinikal na kondisyon na propesyonal lamang ang makapagsusuri.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Your mind and body getting ready for danger, even when nothing is happening yet.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Naghahanda ang isip at katawan mo sa panganib, kahit wala pang nangyayari.
examples: Your heart races and your stomach knots up the night before a big presentation.
Bumibilis ang tibok ng puso mo at sumisikip ang sikmura sa gabi bago ang malaking presentasyon.
questions: Is the worry tied to something specific, or does it float from one thing to another?
Nakatali ba ang pag-aalala sa isang tiyak na bagay, o palipat-lipat ito?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: A lack of interest, enthusiasm or concern about things that would normally matter.
terms.short_definition_fil: Kawalan ng interes, sigla o pakialam sa mga bagay na karaniwang mahalaga.
terms.detailed_definition: Apathy describes not caring, while procrastination usually involves caring but avoiding. Lasting apathy can come with exhaustion or low mood.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ang kawalang-bahala ay hindi pag-aalala o pakialam, samantalang ang pagpapaliban ay kadalasang may pakialam pero umiiwas. Ang matagal na kawalang-bahala ay maaaring kasama ng matinding pagod o mababang mood.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Not caring either way — "whatever".
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Wala nang pakialam kahit ano pa — “bahala na.”
examples: Your favourite show comes on and you cannot be bothered to watch it.
Palabas na ang paborito mong palabas pero tinatamad kang manood.
questions: Is it that you do not care, or that caring feels too heavy right now?
Wala ka ba talagang pakialam, o masyado lang mabigat ang pakialam ngayon?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

Not caring is the core of apathy.
Low motivation is closely tied to apathy.
"Walang gana" (no drive or appetite for things) is close to apathy.
"Tinatamad" (feeling lazy) can sometimes be apathy or exhaustion underneath.

terms.short_definition: The feeling of being in the presence of something vast that is hard to take in, like a mountain view or a starry sky.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam ng pagharap sa isang bagay na napakalawak at mahirap unawain, gaya ng tanawin ng bundok o mabituing langit.
terms.detailed_definition: Researchers Keltner and Haidt describe awe as a response to vastness that changes how we see things. Awe can make personal worries feel smaller and people feel more connected.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilalarawan ng mga mananaliksik na sina Keltner at Haidt ang pagkamangha bilang tugon sa kalawakan na nagbabago sa pagtingin natin sa mga bagay. Napaliliit nito ang personal na alalahanin at napalalapit ang tao sa iba.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling small, in a good way, in front of something big.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na maliit ka, sa magandang paraan, sa harap ng isang malaking bagay.
examples: Watching the sunset over the San Fernando bay.
Pinanonood ang paglubog ng araw sa look ng San Fernando.
questions: When did something last take your breath away?
Kailan ka huling napahinto sa pagkamangha?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: The feeling of being accepted and connected as part of a group or relationship.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam ng pagtanggap at koneksyon bilang bahagi ng isang grupo o relasyon.
terms.detailed_definition: Belonging is considered a basic human need. Its absence is felt as loneliness or exclusion.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Itinuturing na pangunahing pangangailangan ng tao ang pagkakabilang. Kapag wala ito, nararamdaman ito bilang pag-iisa o pagkakaitsapuwera.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling like you have a place where you fit.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na may lugar kang bagay ka.
examples: Laughing with your barkada and feeling fully yourself.
Tumatawa kasama ang barkada at buong-buo kang ikaw.
questions: Where do you feel most like yourself?
Saan mo pinakanararamdaman na ikaw talaga ang sarili mo?

terms.short_definition: An uncomfortable feeling of wanting to be engaged but not being able to.
terms.short_definition_fil: Hindi komportableng pakiramdam ng pagnanais na maging abala pero hindi magawa.
terms.detailed_definition: Researchers describe boredom as trouble keeping attention on what is in front of us. It can be a useful signal to look for something more meaningful, but long-lasting boredom can come with low mood.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilalarawan ng mga mananaliksik ang pagkabagot bilang hirap na ituon ang atensiyon sa nasa harap natin. Maaari itong maging senyales na maghanap ng mas makabuluhan, pero ang matagal na pagkabagot ay maaaring kasama ng mababang mood.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Restless, with nothing that feels worth doing.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Hindi mapakali, at walang tila sulit gawin.
examples: Scrolling for an hour and feeling more bored than before.
Isang oras nag-scroll at lalo pang nabagot.
questions: Is it boredom, or is something heavier underneath?
Pagkabagot ba ito, o may mas mabigat sa ilalim?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: Clear physical, emotional, and mental limits that protect your well-being and delineate where your responsibilities end and others begin.
terms.short_definition_fil: Malinaw na hangganan sa sarili at sa iba upang maprotektahan ang kapayapaan ng isip at lakas.
terms.detailed_definition: Healthy boundaries are not walls to keep people out, but guidelines that allow genuine connection without resentment or emotional exploitation.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi ito pagtataboy sa iba, kundi pagtatakda kung anong kaya at hindi kayang ibigay nang bukal sa loob.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Knowing when to say "no" politely so that your "yes" can be genuine and not rooted in fear.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pagkakaroon ng lakas ng loob na tumanggi nang maayos upang hindi ka maubos sa kakabigay sa iba.
examples: Politely declining an extra project during exam week to protect your sleep schedule.
Maayos na pagtanggi sa karagdagang pabor kapag tambak na ang iyong sariling mga gawain.
questions: Are you saying yes out of fear of conflict, even when it harms your health?
Pumapayag ka ba dahil lang sa takot magalit ang iba, kahit ikaw na ang nahihirapan?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association
cues: Difficulty saying no is a common boundary struggle.
Difficulty saying no is a common boundary struggle.
Feeling taken advantage of can signal that a boundary is being crossed.
Always saying yes, even when it costs you, relates to boundaries.
"Hindi makatanggi" (unable to refuse) is a boundary struggle.

terms.short_definition: A state of physical, emotional, or mental exhaustion associated with prolonged, unmanaged stress.
terms.short_definition_fil: Kalagayan ng matinding pisikal at emosyonal na pagkaubos dulot ng matagalang stress na walang sapat na pahinga.
terms.detailed_definition: Burnout is characterized by emotional depletion, cynicism or mental detachment from responsibilities, and feelings of ineffectiveness. Recognized by the WHO as an occupational phenomenon rather than an isolated mood dip.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Kinikilala ng World Health Organization bilang kalagayan ng patuloy na pagkaubos ng lakas, paglayo ng loob sa mga gawain, at pagbaba ng tiwala sa sariling kakayahan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling so thoroughly depleted by persistent demands that ordinary rest no longer seems to restore your energy.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na ubos na ubos ka na, kung saan kahit matulog o magpahinga ka ay pagod ka pa rin paggising.
examples: Dreading waking up for classes or work every morning for weeks, feeling like you are operating on empty.
Araw-araw kang nagigising na parang ubos na ang lakas mo at mabigat ang bawat hakbang bago magsimula ang araw.
questions: Has this feeling of depletion persisted even when you've had weekends or breaks to rest?
Nanatili ba ang matinding pagod kahit nagkaroon ka na ng oras magpahinga?
Do everyday responsibilities feel unusually burdensome or detached?
Pakiramdam mo ba ay nawawalan ka na ng gana sa mga gawaing dati mong nagagawa nang maayos?

terms.short_definition: A settled state of body and mind, with slow breathing and few pressing thoughts.
terms.short_definition_fil: Panatag na kalagayan ng katawan at isip, na may mabagal na paghinga at kakaunting nagmamadaling isipin.
terms.detailed_definition: Calm is something the body can be guided toward: slow breathing, grounding and gentle movement all help the nervous system settle after stress.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maaaring gabayan ang katawan patungo sa kahinahunan: nakatutulong ang mabagal na paghinga, grounding at banayad na paggalaw para kumalma ang nervous system matapos ang stress.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Quiet inside, like still water.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Tahimik sa loob, parang payapang tubig.
examples: Feeling your shoulders drop after a few slow breaths.
Naramdaman mong bumaba ang balikat mo matapos ang ilang mabagal na paghinga.
questions: Where in your body do you feel calm when it comes?
Saan sa katawan mo nararamdaman ang kahinahunan kapag dumarating ito?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

terms.short_definition: A prolonged and continuous state of physiological and psychological arousal in response to enduring pressures.
terms.short_definition_fil: Matagalang tensyon sa katawan at isip dahil sa tuloy-tuloy na problemang walang agarang lunas.
terms.detailed_definition: Unlike acute stress which subsides once a situation resolves, chronic stress keeps cortisol and adrenaline elevated, taxing sleep, digestion, and emotional resilience.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi tulad ng karaniwang kaba na nawawala agad, ang matagalang stress ay nagpapanatili sa tensyon ng kalamnan, sakit ng ulo, at pagkabalisa.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling like your nervous system is perpetually on high alert with no quiet period to recover.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na laging alerto at tensyonado ang katawan mo, na parang laging may nakaambang problema.
examples: Worrying about family expenses, academic grades, and health difficulties every single day for months.
Araw-araw na pag-aalala sa gastusin sa pamilya at grado nang walang patid sa loob ng ilang buwan.
questions: Do you notice physical signs like jaw clenching, tight shoulders, or stomach knots during rest?
Napapansin mo ba ang pananakit ng batok, balikat, o tiyan kahit walang ginagawa?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

Church, A. T., Katigbak, M. S., Reyes, J. A. S., & Jensen, S. M. (1998). Cognition and Emotion, 12(1), 63–92
cues: Stress that never switches off may be chronic rather than short-term.
Pressure that has lasted months fits the idea of chronic stress.
Pressure that returns every day can become chronic stress.
Pressure that never ends is the defining feature of chronic stress.
Feeling constantly on alert is a common sign of prolonged stress.

terms.short_definition: Being moved by someone’s suffering and wanting to help.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagkaantig sa paghihirap ng iba at kagustuhang tumulong.
terms.detailed_definition: Compassion combines feeling for someone with a wish to act. It can be directed at others or at yourself (self-compassion).
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Pinagsasama ng habag ang pakikiramdam sa iba at ang kagustuhang kumilos. Maaari itong ituon sa iba o sa sarili (malasakit sa sarili).
terms.in_simpler_terms: Seeing someone hurting and wanting to help.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Nakikita ang sakit ng iba at gustong tumulong.
questions: How do you like to be helped when you are hurting?
Paano mo gustong matulungan kapag nasasaktan ka?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

Goetz, J. L., Keltner, D., & Simon-Thomas, E. (2010). Psychological Bulletin, 136(3), 351–374
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

terms.short_definition: Exhaustion and reduced ability to feel empathy that can develop from caring for people who are suffering.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagkahapo at paghina ng kakayahang makiramay dahil sa matagal na pag-aalaga sa mga nagdurusa.
terms.detailed_definition: Described by Charles Figley in work with helpers and caregivers. It can affect nurses, teachers, counselors, family caregivers and peer supporters.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilarawan ito ni Charles Figley sa kanyang pag-aaral sa mga tagatulong at tagapag-alaga. Maaari itong maranasan ng mga nars, guro, counselor, tagapag-alaga sa pamilya at peer supporter.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Caring for others for so long that you start to feel numb or worn out by it.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Matagal kang nag-alaga ng iba kaya parang namamanhid o napapagod ka na rito.
examples: A volunteer notices they no longer feel moved by stories that used to affect them deeply.
Napansin ng isang boluntaryo na hindi na siya naaantig sa mga kuwentong dati ay tumatagos sa kanya.
questions: Do you spend much of your time supporting people who are going through hard things?
Malaking bahagi ba ng oras mo ang pagsuporta sa mga taong dumaraan sa hirap?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
Compassion Fatigue: Coping with Secondary Traumatic Stress Disorder
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association
cues: Long-term caregiving is the setting where compassion fatigue appears.
Constantly caring for others can lead to compassion fatigue.
A drop in empathy after long caregiving is the core of compassion fatigue.

terms.short_definition: A calm, settled satisfaction with how things are, without needing more right now.
terms.short_definition_fil: Kalmado at panatag na kasiyahan sa kalagayan, nang hindi naghahanap ng higit pa ngayon.
terms.detailed_definition: Contentment is a quieter positive emotion than joy. It often comes after needs are met, such as after a meal, rest or finishing a task.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Mas tahimik na positibong damdamin ang kapanatagan kaysa galak. Kadalasang dumarating ito kapag natugunan ang pangangailangan, gaya ng pagkatapos kumain, magpahinga o tapusin ang isang gawain.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling that this is enough, for now.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na sapat na ito, sa ngayon.
examples: Sitting on the porch after dinner, full and unhurried.
Nakaupo sa balkonahe pagkatapos ng hapunan, busog at walang minamadali.
questions: When did you last feel “this is enough”?
Kailan mo huling naramdaman na “sapat na ito”?

terms.short_definition: The thoughts and actions people use to handle stress and difficult situations.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang mga isip at kilos na ginagamit ng tao para harapin ang stress at mahihirap na sitwasyon.
terms.detailed_definition: Lazarus and Folkman described problem-focused coping (changing the situation) and emotion-focused coping (managing feelings about it). Both are useful at different times. Some ways of coping, like avoiding everything, help short-term but can backfire.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilarawan nina Lazarus at Folkman ang pagharap na nakatuon sa problema (pagbabago ng sitwasyon) at sa damdamin (pamamahala sa nararamdaman). Parehong kapaki-pakinabang sa magkaibang panahon. Ang ilang paraan, gaya ng pag-iwas sa lahat, ay nakatutulong sandali pero maaaring makasama.
terms.in_simpler_terms: How you get through hard things.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Paano mo nalalampasan ang mahihirap na bagay.
questions: What has helped you cope before?
Ano ang nakatulong sa iyo na makaraos dati?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: A professional relationship in which a trained counselor helps a person work through personal, emotional or practical difficulties.
terms.short_definition_fil: Propesyonal na ugnayan kung saan tinutulungan ng sinanay na counselor ang tao sa personal, emosyonal o praktikal na suliranin.
terms.detailed_definition: Schools often have guidance counselors. Counseling is not only for crises; it can help with stress, decisions and relationships.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Kadalasang may guidance counselor ang mga paaralan. Hindi lang para sa krisis ang pagpapayo; makatutulong din ito sa stress, pagpapasya at relasyon.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Talking things through with someone trained to help.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakikipag-usap sa taong sinanay para tumulong.
questions: Does your school or workplace have a counselor you could book a time with?
May counselor ba sa paaralan o trabaho mo na puwede mong kausapin?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

Republic Act No. 11036 — Mental Health Act

terms.short_definition: Immediate, short-term help for someone in acute emotional distress or danger, focused on safety and stabilisation.
terms.short_definition_fil: Agarang panandaliang tulong para sa taong nasa matinding emosyonal na pagkabalisa o panganib, nakatuon sa kaligtasan.
terms.detailed_definition: Crisis lines and emergency services provide crisis intervention. If someone is in immediate danger, contact emergency services.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Nagbibigay ng agarang tulong sa krisis ang mga crisis line at emergency service. Kung may agarang panganib, tumawag sa emergency service.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Urgent help focused on getting someone safe right now.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Mabilisang tulong para maging ligtas ang tao ngayon din.
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

cues: You mentioned a crisis. If you or someone is in danger, contact emergency services or a crisis line now.
If this is an emergency, please call 911 or the NCMH crisis line 1553.

terms.short_definition: Wanting to know, explore or understand something new.
terms.short_definition_fil: Kagustuhang malaman, tuklasin o unawain ang bagong bagay.
terms.detailed_definition: Curiosity can also be turned inward: getting curious about a feeling instead of judging it is a step used in mindfulness.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maaari ding ibaling sa loob ang pagkamausisa: ang pagiging mausisa sa isang damdamin sa halip na husgahan ito ay hakbang na ginagamit sa mindfulness.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Wondering “what is this?” and wanting to find out.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Nagtataka “ano ito?” at gustong malaman.
questions: What are you curious about lately?
Ano ang kinasasabikan mong malaman nitong mga araw?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

terms.short_definition: A clinical mood disorder marked by persistent low mood, loss of interest in activities, and changes in sleep, energy, and self-worth lasting two weeks or more.
terms.short_definition_fil: Klinikal na karamdaman sa mood kung saan may patuloy na pagkawala ng gana, kawalan ng pag-asa, at pagbaba ng sigla sa loob ng dalawang linggo o higit pa.
terms.detailed_definition: Major Depressive Disorder is not merely sadness or weakness; it is a serious medical condition involving neurochemical and cognitive changes that interfere with daily life.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi ito simpleng pag-iinarte o kawalan ng pananampalataya; isa itong medikal na kondisyon na nangangailangan ng propesyonal na kalinga at pag-unawa.
terms.in_simpler_terms: A persistent grey cloud where feelings of pleasure, energy, and self-worth seem entirely muted, regardless of external circumstances.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na parang nababalot ka ng dilim kung saan walang nagpapasaya sa iyo at mabigat ang bawat minuto ng araw.
examples: Finding it difficult to get out of bed for three straight weeks and having zero interest in hobbies you previously loved.
Tatlong linggo nang nahihirapang bumangon sa kama at wala nang maramdamang interes sa mga paboritong gawain.
questions: Has this heavy numbness or despair lasted nearly every day for more than two weeks?
Tumagal na ba ang ganitong kawalan ng gana nang mahigit dalawang linggo?
Would you consider reaching out to the psychiatry clinic at ITRMC or calling 1553?
Bukas ka ba sa pakikipag-ugnayan sa doktor sa ITRMC o pagtawag sa 1553 para sa ligtas na gabay?

terms.short_definition: Losing confidence or enthusiasm after setbacks or when progress feels out of reach.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagkawala ng tiwala o sigla matapos ang mga kabiguan o kapag tila malayo ang pag-unlad.
terms.detailed_definition: Discouragement is tied to specific goals or efforts, which makes it different from wider hopelessness.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Nakatali ang panghihina ng loob sa tiyak na layunin o pagsisikap, kaya iba ito sa mas malawak na kawalan ng pag-asa.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling like your effort isn't getting you anywhere, so why keep trying.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Parang walang napupuntahan ang pagsisikap mo, kaya bakit pa susubok.
examples: Failing a quiz after studying hard and wondering if it is worth trying again.
Bumagsak ka sa quiz kahit nag-aral nang mabuti at napaisip kung sulit pang sumubok ulit.
questions: What small sign of progress might you be overlooking?
Anong maliit na senyales ng pag-unlad ang maaaring hindi mo napapansin?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
cues: Wanting to give up after setbacks reflects discouragement.
Feeling that effort is no use is discouragement.
Not wanting to try anything can follow repeated discouragement.

terms.short_definition: A disconnection from your thoughts, feelings, surroundings or sense of self.
terms.short_definition_fil: Paghiwalay o pagkakawalay sa iyong isip, damdamin, paligid o pakiramdam sa sarili.
terms.detailed_definition: Mild dissociation, like zoning out, is common. More intense experiences, such as feeling unreal or watching yourself from outside, can follow severe stress and are worth discussing with a professional.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Karaniwan ang banayad na disosasyon, gaya ng pagkatulala. Ang mas matinding karanasan, gaya ng pakiramdam na hindi totoo ang paligid o pinanonood mo ang sarili mula sa labas, ay maaaring sumunod sa matinding stress at mainam na ikonsulta sa propesyonal.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling far away from yourself or the world, like watching through glass.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na malayo ka sa sarili o sa mundo, parang nakatingin sa salamin.
examples: Feeling like you are watching your own life from far away.
Parang pinanonood mo ang sarili mong buhay mula sa malayo.
questions: Does grounding (naming what you see and hear) bring you back a little?
Nakatutulong ba ang grounding (pagpapangalan sa nakikita at naririnig) para makabalik ka nang kaunti?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

cues: Feeling far away from yourself or your life is how dissociation is often described.
Watching your life as if from outside describes dissociation.
Feeling that things are not real can be dissociation.
Feeling detached is a sign of dissociation.
Going through life on autopilot can be a mild form of dissociation.

terms.short_definition: The ability to get through intense emotional pain without making the situation worse.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang kakayahang malampasan ang matinding sakit ng damdamin nang hindi pinalalala ang sitwasyon.
terms.detailed_definition: A set of skills taught in Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), such as temporarily distracting yourself or self-soothing with the senses, aimed at surviving a crisis moment.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Mga kasanayang itinuturo sa Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), gaya ng pansamantalang paglilibang o pagpapakalma gamit ang mga pandama, para malampasan ang sandali ng krisis.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Getting through the worst moment, one minute at a time.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Malampasan ang pinakamahirap na sandali, isang minuto sa isang pagkakataon.
questions: What has helped you get through a very hard hour before?
Ano ang nakatulong sa iyo dati para malampasan ang isang napakahirap na oras?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: A short-lived reaction to something that matters to you, felt in the body and mind, such as joy, fear, anger or sadness.
terms.short_definition_fil: Panandaliang reaksiyon sa bagay na mahalaga sa iyo, nararamdaman sa katawan at isip, gaya ng tuwa, takot, galit o lungkot.
terms.detailed_definition: Emotions carry information: they tell you what matters and prepare you to act. No emotion is “bad” to feel, even when what we do with it can cause harm. Filipino has rich emotion words, such as tampo, gigil and kilig, that English has no single word for.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: May dalang impormasyon ang damdamin: sinasabi nito kung ano ang mahalaga at inihahanda kang kumilos. Walang damdaming “masama” na maramdaman, kahit ang ginagawa natin dito ay maaaring makasakit. Mayaman ang Filipino sa salita para sa damdamin, gaya ng tampo, gigil at kilig.
terms.in_simpler_terms: What you feel inside when something matters.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang nararamdaman mo sa loob kapag may mahalagang nangyayari.
questions: What emotion is strongest for you right now?
Anong damdamin ang pinakamalakas sa iyo ngayon?
sources: Language and organisation of Filipino emotion concepts: Comparing emotion concepts and dimensions across cultures

terms.short_definition: Feeling emotionally drained and depleted after giving or coping for a long time.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam na ubos na ang emosyonal na lakas matapos ang matagal na pagbibigay o pagtitiis.
terms.detailed_definition: Emotional exhaustion is a sense of having nothing left to give emotionally. It is one of the core dimensions in research on burnout, but it can also follow caregiving, grief, or long conflict.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Pakiramdam na wala ka nang maibibigay sa damdamin. Isa ito sa mga pangunahing sukat sa pananaliksik tungkol sa burnout, pero maaari ding sumunod sa pag-aalaga, pagdadalamhati o matagal na alitan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Your emotional battery is empty, and even small feelings take effort.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ubos na ang baterya ng damdamin mo, at kahit maliliit na pakiramdam ay nakapapagod.
examples: After weeks of caring for a sick parent, even a friendly message feels like too much to answer.
Matapos ang ilang linggong pag-aalaga sa may-sakit na magulang, kahit magiliw na mensahe ay parang sobra nang sagutin.
questions: Is there something that has been asking a lot of you emotionally for a long time?
May bagay bang matagal nang humihingi ng malaki sa damdamin mo?

Feeling drained points to depleted emotional energy.
Tiredness that is emotional rather than physical can be emotional exhaustion.
When feelings have been "too much" for a long time, exhaustion can follow.
"Ubos na" (all used up) describes depleted emotional energy.

terms.short_definition: A reduced ability to feel emotions, both painful and pleasant.
terms.short_definition_fil: Paghina ng kakayahang makaramdam ng emosyon, masakit man o masaya.
terms.detailed_definition: Numbness can be a temporary way the mind protects itself after overwhelming stress or loss. When it lasts, it is worth discussing with a professional.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maaaring pansamantalang paraan ng isip ang pamamanhid para protektahan ang sarili matapos ang labis na stress o pagkawala. Kapag tumatagal, mainam itong ikonsulta sa propesyonal.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Like your feelings have been turned down to zero.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Parang hininaan hanggang zero ang mga damdamin mo.
examples: Hearing good news and noticing you feel nothing at all.
Nakarinig ka ng magandang balita at napansin mong wala kang naramdaman.
questions: Did the numbness start after something overwhelming?
Nagsimula ba ang pamamanhid matapos ang isang napakabigat na pangyayari?

terms.short_definition: The ways people influence which emotions they have, when, and how they experience and express them.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang mga paraan ng pag-impluwensya sa nararamdaman, kung kailan, at paano ito nararanasan at ipinapahayag.
terms.detailed_definition: Everyone regulates emotions, through rest, talking, distraction, reframing or movement. Difficulty regulating is common under stress and can be strengthened with practice and support.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Lahat ay namamahala sa damdamin — sa pagpapahinga, pakikipag-usap, paglilibang, pagtingin sa ibang anggulo, o paggalaw. Karaniwan ang hirap dito kapag stressed, at napalalakas ito sa pagsasanay at suporta.
terms.in_simpler_terms: How you steer your feelings so they don't steer you.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Kung paano mo ginagabayan ang damdamin para hindi ito ang gumagabay sa iyo.
examples: Taking a walk before replying to an upsetting message.
Naglakad-lakad ka muna bago sumagot sa nakasasakit na mensahe.
questions: What helps you come back to steady after a strong feeling?
Ano ang nakatutulong para bumalik ka sa kalmado matapos ang matinding damdamin?

Very intense emotions are where regulation skills help.
Feeling like you will explode emotionally relates to regulation.

terms.short_definition: Understanding and sharing what another person feels, from their point of view.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pag-unawa at pakikibahagi sa nararamdaman ng ibang tao, mula sa kanilang pananaw.
terms.detailed_definition: Filipino pakikiramdam goes a step further: sensing what others feel and need, often without words. Empathy helps relationships, but carrying everyone’s feelings without rest can lead to compassion fatigue.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Higit pa rito ang pakikiramdam ng Pilipino: ang pagdama sa nararamdaman at kailangan ng iba, madalas nang walang salita. Nakatutulong ang empatiya sa relasyon, pero ang pagdadala ng damdamin ng lahat nang walang pahinga ay maaaring humantong sa pagkapagod sa pagmamalasakit.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling with someone, not just for them.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakikiramdam kasama ng tao, hindi lang para sa kanya.
examples: Noticing a friend has gone quiet and sitting beside them without asking too much.
Napansin mong tumahimik ang kaibigan at tumabi ka sa kanya nang hindi masyadong nagtatanong.
questions: How do you show someone you understand?
Paano mo ipinapakita sa iba na nauunawaan mo sila?

terms.short_definition: A feeling of inner hollowness, as if something meaningful is missing.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam ng kahungkagan sa loob, na parang may nawawalang mahalaga.
terms.detailed_definition: Emptiness is often described alongside loneliness, low mood or loss of meaning. Persistent emptiness is worth talking through with someone you trust or a professional.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Madalas ilarawan ang kahungkagan kasama ng pag-iisa, mababang mood o pagkawala ng kahulugan. Kapag nagpapatuloy, mainam itong pag-usapan kasama ang taong pinagkakatiwalaan o propesyonal.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling hollow inside, like there is a space where something should be.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Parang guwang sa loob, na parang may espasyong dapat may laman.
examples: Going through the day doing everything right, yet feeling nothing inside.
Ginawa mo nang tama ang lahat buong araw pero wala kang maramdaman sa loob.
questions: When did you last feel that something mattered to you?
Kailan mo huling naramdaman na may mahalaga sa iyo?

APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

A sense that nothing matters can come with emptiness.
"Parang walang laman" (like nothing inside) describes emptiness.

terms.short_definition: An energised, eager feeling about something you are looking forward to.
terms.short_definition_fil: Masigla at sabik na pakiramdam tungkol sa bagay na inaabangan mo.
terms.detailed_definition: Excitement and anxiety feel similar in the body (racing heart, butterflies). The difference is often in how we read the situation.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Magkatulad sa katawan ang pananabik at pagkabalisa (mabilis na tibok ng puso, kiliti sa tiyan). Kadalasan, nasa paraan ng pagtingin natin sa sitwasyon ang pagkakaiba.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Butterflies, the good kind.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Kiliti sa tiyan, iyong masarap na uri.
examples: Counting down the days to a trip home.
Binibilang ang mga araw bago ang pag-uwi.
questions: Could some of the nervousness you feel be excitement too?
Maaari bang may halong pananabik ang kaba na nararamdaman mo?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

terms.short_definition: An everyday way of saying that your physical or emotional energy has run low.
terms.short_definition_fil: Karaniwang paraan ng pagsasabing paubos na ang iyong lakas, pisikal man o emosyonal.
terms.detailed_definition: A broad everyday expression. It can describe a single tiring day or a longer pattern; noticing how long it lasts helps tell which.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Pang-araw-araw na pananalita ito. Maaaring tumukoy sa isang nakapapagod na araw o sa mas matagal na pattern; ang pagpansin kung gaano katagal ito ang tumutulong para malaman kung alin.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Like a phone at 5%: still on, but running on very little.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Parang cellphone na 5% na lang: bukas pa, pero halos wala nang laman.
examples: After a long day of classes and chores, you sit down and cannot bring yourself to do anything else.
Matapos ang mahabang araw ng klase at gawaing-bahay, umupo ka at hindi mo na mapilit ang sarili na gumawa ng iba pa.
questions: Does the drained feeling lift after rest, or does it stay?
Nawawala ba ang pagkaubos pagkatapos magpahinga, o nananatili?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
Maslach, C., & Jackson, S. E. (1981). Journal of Occupational Behaviour, 2(2), 99–113
cues: "Running on empty" is another way to say drained.
Having no energy is what feeling drained describes.
Tiredness is closely related to feeling drained.
"Walang lakas" (no strength) is close to feeling drained.

terms.short_definition: Being so absorbed in an activity that time seems to disappear.
terms.short_definition_fil: Lubos na pagkalubog sa isang gawain na parang naglalaho ang oras.
terms.detailed_definition: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi described flow as happening when a task is challenging enough to engage you but not so hard that it overwhelms you.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilarawan ni Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi na nangyayari ang flow kapag sapat na mahirap ang gawain para maakit ka pero hindi gaanong mahirap na nakalulunod.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Losing track of time because you are fully into what you are doing.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Hindi mo namamalayan ang oras dahil buong-buo ka sa ginagawa.
examples: Drawing for hours and being surprised it is already dark.
Ilang oras kang gumuguhit at nagulat kang madilim na pala.
questions: What activity makes you lose track of time?
Anong gawain ang nagpapalimot sa iyo sa oras?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
Flow: The Psychology of Optimal Experience

terms.short_definition: The feeling of being blocked from doing or getting something you want or need.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam ng pagkahadlang sa paggawa o pagkuha ng isang bagay na gusto o kailangan mo.
terms.detailed_definition: Frustration is closely linked to anger but centres on obstacles and effort that does not pay off.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Malapit sa galit ang pagkadismaya pero nakatuon ito sa mga balakid at pagsisikap na hindi nagbubunga.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Trying and trying, and still hitting the same wall.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Subok nang subok, pero iisang pader pa rin ang nababangga.
examples: Rewriting a paragraph five times and still not getting it right.
Limang beses mo nang isinulat muli ang talata pero hindi pa rin tama.
questions: What is the wall you keep hitting?
Ano ang pader na paulit-ulit mong nababangga?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
Language and organisation of Filipino emotion concepts: Comparing emotion concepts and dimensions across cultures
Church, A. T., Katigbak, M. S., Reyes, J. A. S., & Jensen, S. M. (1998). Cognition and Emotion, 12(1), 63–92
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association
cues: When nothing you try works, frustration builds.
Feeling stuck against an obstacle is frustration.

terms.short_definition: A clinical condition involving excessive, hard-to-control worry about many areas of life, most days, for months.
terms.short_definition_fil: Klinikal na kondisyon ng labis at mahirap kontroling pag-aalala sa maraming bagay, halos araw-araw, sa loob ng ilang buwan.
terms.detailed_definition: GAD is diagnosed by qualified professionals using specific criteria. Feeling anxious, even often, does not by itself mean someone has GAD. This entry is here so the term is understood, not to self-assess.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Mga kuwalipikadong propesyonal ang nagdi-diagnose ng GAD gamit ang tiyak na pamantayan. Ang madalas na pagkabalisa ay hindi nangangahulugang may GAD na. Narito ang salitang ito para maunawaan, hindi para sa sariling pagsusuri.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Worry that spreads to almost everything and is very hard to switch off, over a long time.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pag-aalalang kumakalat sa halos lahat ng bagay at napakahirap patayin, sa mahabang panahon.
questions: If worry has been affecting your daily life for a long time, would you consider talking to a professional?
Kung matagal nang naaapektuhan ng pag-aalala ang araw-araw mo, handa ka bang makipag-usap sa propesyonal?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

terms.short_definition: Noticing and appreciating the good things in your life and the people who helped bring them.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagpansin at pagpapahalaga sa mabubuting bagay sa buhay at sa mga taong tumulong para mangyari ang mga ito.
terms.detailed_definition: Studies of simple practices, like writing down a few things you are thankful for each week, found small improvements in mood and well-being. Gratitude works alongside, not instead of, acknowledging what is hard. Filipino utang na loob is related but also carries a sense of lasting debt.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Sa mga pag-aaral ng simpleng gawain, gaya ng pagsulat ng ilang bagay na ipinagpapasalamat bawat linggo, may nakitang maliit na pagbuti sa mood at kagalingan. Kasabay ito, hindi kapalit, ng pagkilala sa mahirap. Kaugnay ang utang na loob ng Pilipino pero may dala itong pakiramdam ng pangmatagalang pagkakautang.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Noticing what is good, and who made it possible.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pagpansin sa mabuti, at kung sino ang tumulong para mangyari ito.
examples: Thanking the jeepney driver who waited for you in the rain.
Nagpasalamat sa tsuper ng dyip na naghintay sa iyo sa ulan.
questions: Who is someone you are thankful for this week?
Sino ang isang taong ipinagpapasalamat mo ngayong linggo?

terms.short_definition: The deep sorrow and many other feelings that follow a loss, especially the death of someone close.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang malalim na lungkot at iba pang damdamin na sumusunod sa pagkawala, lalo na ng isang mahal sa buhay.
terms.detailed_definition: Grief is not only sadness. It can include anger, guilt, numbness, relief, and longing, and it does not follow a neat order. Grief can also follow other losses: a relationship, a home, health, or a future you expected.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi lang kalungkutan ang pagdadalamhati. Maaari itong may galit, pagkakonsensiya, pamamanhid, ginhawa at pananabik, at hindi ito sumusunod sa malinis na pagkakasunod-sunod. Maaari din itong sumunod sa ibang pagkawala: relasyon, tahanan, kalusugan, o kinabukasang inaasahan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: The way love keeps hurting after you lose someone or something.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang paraan ng pagmamahal na patuloy na sumasakit matapos mawalan ng tao o bagay.
examples: Months after a grandparent's death, a smell in the kitchen suddenly brings the loss back.
Ilang buwan matapos pumanaw ang lolo o lola, isang amoy sa kusina ang biglang nagpaalala ng pagkawala.
questions: What or who are you missing?
Sino o ano ang hinahanap-hanap mo?

Losing someone to death brings grief.
Longing for someone you lost is part of grief.
Loss is the root of grief.
Death of a loved one (namatay) brings grief.

terms.short_definition: Mindfulness and sensory strategies designed to anchor your awareness in the physical reality of the present moment.
terms.short_definition_fil: Mga simpleng paraan gamit ang paningin, pandinig, at pandama upang ibalik ang isip sa kasalukuyang sandali.
terms.detailed_definition: Grounding interrupts panic loops, flashbacks, and cognitive spirals by stimulating the senses, activating the parasympathetic nervous system.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Pumuputol sa labis na kaba at pag-iisip sa pamamagitan ng pagtutok sa mga bagay na nakikita, naririnig, at nahihipo.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Using your five senses (what you see, touch, hear) to bring your frantic brain back into the calm room.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Paggamit ng pandama—paghawak sa malamig na baso, pagbilang ng kulay sa paligid—upang kumalma.
examples: Feeling your feet planted firmly on the floor and naming five green things in the room when your heart races.
Pagdama sa mga paa sa sahig at pagbilang ng limang bagay sa paligid kapag bumibilis ang tibok ng puso.
questions: Can you notice the temperature of the air on your skin right now?
Nararamdaman mo ba ang simoy ng hangin sa iyong balat ngayon?

cues: If you are looking for ways to calm down, grounding is one practical skill.
Grounding is often used to steady yourself during a wave of panic.
Feeling disconnected from what is real is something grounding exercises can help with.

terms.short_definition: A painful feeling that you have done something wrong or failed to do something you should have.
terms.short_definition_fil: Masakit na pakiramdam na may nagawa kang mali o may hindi nagawang dapat ginawa.
terms.detailed_definition: Guilt focuses on an action ("I did a bad thing"). It can be useful when it leads to repair. Shame, by contrast, focuses on the self ("I am bad").
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Nakatuon ang pagkakonsensiya sa isang gawa (“May nagawa akong mali”). Nakatutulong ito kapag humahantong sa pag-aayos. Ang hiya naman ay nakatuon sa sarili (“Masama ako”).
terms.in_simpler_terms: "I did something wrong" — and it keeps bothering you.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: “May nagawa akong mali” — at patuloy kang ginugulo nito.
examples: Feeling awful for snapping at a friend and wanting to apologize.
Masama ang loob mo dahil nasigawan mo ang kaibigan at gusto mong humingi ng tawad.
questions: Is the feeling about something you did, or about who you are?
Tungkol ba ang pakiramdam sa isang ginawa mo, o sa kung sino ka?

"I should have…" thinking often comes with guilt.

terms.short_definition: A general sense that life is going well, made up of frequent positive feelings and satisfaction with life.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pangkalahatang pakiramdam na maayos ang takbo ng buhay, binubuo ng madalas na magagandang damdamin at kasiyahan sa buhay.
terms.detailed_definition: Happiness is not constant cheerfulness. It tends to grow from relationships, meaning, rest and small daily pleasures, and people who feel happier more often also tend to do better in health, work and relationships.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi palagiang pagiging masigla ang kaligayahan. Lumalago ito mula sa relasyon, kahulugan, pahinga at maliliit na kasiyahan araw-araw, at ang mga mas madalas maligaya ay kadalasang mas maayos din sa kalusugan, trabaho at relasyon.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling good about your life, most of the time.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Maayos ang pakiramdam sa buhay, kadalasan.
questions: What does a happy ordinary day look like for you?
Ano ang itsura ng isang masayang karaniwang araw para sa iyo?

terms.short_definition: Feeling that you have no power to change your situation.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam na wala kang kapangyarihang baguhin ang iyong sitwasyon.
terms.detailed_definition: Psychologist Martin Seligman described "learned helplessness": after repeated situations where effort made no difference, people may stop trying even when change becomes possible.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilarawan ni Martin Seligman ang “learned helplessness”: matapos ang paulit-ulit na sitwasyong walang epekto ang pagsisikap, maaaring huminto ang tao sa pagsubok kahit posible na ang pagbabago.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling like nothing you do will make a difference.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na walang magbabago anuman ang gawin mo.
examples: After many rejected applications, not sending the next one even though it might work.
Matapos ang maraming tinanggihang aplikasyon, hindi mo na ipinadala ang susunod kahit baka matanggap ito.
questions: Is there one small part of the situation you can still influence?
May isang maliit na bahagi ba ng sitwasyon na kaya mo pang impluwensiyahan?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
Seligman, M. E. P., & Maier, S. F. (1967). Journal of Experimental Psychology, 74(1), 1–9
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association
cues: Believing nothing you do matters is helplessness.
"Walang magawa" (nothing I can do) describes helplessness.

terms.short_definition: Believing that things can get better, and that you can find ways to get there.
terms.short_definition_fil: Paniniwalang may pagbabagong darating, at na makahahanap ka ng paraan para makarating doon.
terms.detailed_definition: Psychologist C. R. Snyder described hope as having goals, seeing ways to reach them, and the will to keep going. Hope can be rebuilt in small steps, and borrowed from others when yours runs low.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilarawan ng sikologong si C. R. Snyder ang pag-asa bilang pagkakaroon ng layunin, nakikitang paraan para maabot ito, at kagustuhang magpatuloy. Muling naitatayo ang pag-asa sa maliliit na hakbang, at puwedeng hiramin sa iba kapag paubos na ang sa iyo.
terms.in_simpler_terms: A small light ahead, and a path toward it.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Maliit na liwanag sa unahan, at daan patungo roon.
examples: After a hard term, signing up for tutoring because you believe next term can go better.
Matapos ang mahirap na semestre, nag-sign up ka sa tutoring dahil naniniwala kang gaganda ang susunod.
questions: What is one thing you are looking forward to?
Ano ang isang bagay na inaabangan mo?

terms.short_definition: The belief that things will not get better and that nothing you do will change them.
terms.short_definition_fil: Paniniwalang hindi na bubuti ang mga bagay at walang magagawa para magbago ito.
terms.detailed_definition: Hopelessness is a serious feeling to take care of. If it comes with thoughts of not wanting to be alive, please contact a crisis line or someone you trust right away.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Seryosong damdamin ang kawalan ng pag-asa na dapat alagaan. Kung may kasamang isipin na ayaw nang mabuhay, makipag-ugnayan agad sa crisis line o sa taong pinagkakatiwalaan mo.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling like the future is closed and nothing will change.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na sarado na ang kinabukasan at walang magbabago.
questions: Who is one person you could tell about this feeling today?
Sino ang isang taong puwede mong sabihan tungkol sa pakiramdam na ito ngayong araw?

Believing things will never improve is hopelessness.

terms.short_definition: Feeling like a fraud who does not deserve your achievements, despite evidence of your abilities.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam na isa kang mapagpanggap na hindi karapat-dapat sa iyong mga nagawa, kahit may patunay ng iyong kakayahan.
terms.detailed_definition: First described by Clance and Imes as the "impostor phenomenon". It is a common experience, not a diagnosis.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Unang inilarawan nina Clance at Imes bilang “impostor phenomenon.” Karaniwang karanasan ito, hindi diagnosis.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling like you got here by luck and will be "found out".
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na nakarating ka rito dahil sa suwerte at mabibisto ka.
examples: Getting into a good program and worrying that the school made a mistake.
Natanggap ka sa magandang programa at nag-aalala kang nagkamali ang paaralan.
questions: What evidence would a friend point to that you earned this?
Anong patunay ang ituturo ng kaibigan na pinaghirapan mo ito?

Fearing being "found out" is typical of impostor feelings.
Feeling you do not deserve success relates to impostor feelings.

terms.short_definition: The harsh inner voice that judges, blames or puts you down.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang malupit na tinig sa loob na humuhusga, sumisisi o nagpapababa sa iyo.
terms.detailed_definition: Many people have an inner critic. Noticing and naming it can create a bit of distance from it, which is a step used in several self-help and therapy approaches.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maraming tao ang may panloob na kritiko. Ang pagpansin at pagpapangalan dito ay nakalilikha ng kaunting distansya, isang hakbang na ginagamit sa ilang self-help at therapy.
terms.in_simpler_terms: That voice in your head that says you messed up again.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang boses sa isip mo na nagsasabing nagkamali ka na naman.
examples: Making a small mistake and hearing yourself think "you always ruin everything".
Nagkamali ka nang kaunti at narinig mo sa isip: “Lagi mo na lang sinisira ang lahat.”
questions: What would a kinder voice say about the same situation?
Ano ang sasabihin ng mas mabait na boses tungkol sa parehong sitwasyon?

Self-compassion: An alternative conceptualization of a healthy attitude toward oneself

cues: Being hard on yourself is the inner critic at work.
"I always mess up" is classic inner-critic language.
Calling yourself stupid is often the inner critic talking.
Blaming yourself is a voice of the inner critic.

terms.short_definition: Feeling uncertain about your worth, abilities or place with others.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam na hindi sigurado sa iyong halaga, kakayahan o lugar sa iba.
terms.detailed_definition: Insecurity often shows up in specific areas, such as looks, relationships or school, and it can make people compare themselves to others constantly.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Kadalasang lumilitaw ito sa tiyak na bahagi ng buhay, gaya ng itsura, relasyon o pag-aaral, at nagpapadalas ng paghahambing sa iba.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Doubting yourself, especially next to other people.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pagdududa sa sarili, lalo na kapag katabi ang ibang tao.
examples: Scrolling through classmates' posts and feeling behind everyone.
Nag-scroll ka sa mga post ng mga kaklase at pakiramdam mo ay naiiwan ka.
questions: Where does the comparison usually start?
Saan kadalasang nagsisimula ang paghahambing?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association
cues: Comparing yourself to others is a hallmark of insecurity.
Believing everyone is better than you reflects insecurity.
Self-doubt is insecurity about your abilities.

terms.short_definition: Being easily annoyed or quick to anger, often over small things.
terms.short_definition_fil: Madaling mainis o magalit, kadalasan sa maliliit na bagay.
terms.detailed_definition: Irritability is often a sign that someone is stretched thin — tired, stressed, in pain, or low in mood — rather than a personality trait.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Kadalasang senyales ang pagkamainisin na sobrang nababanat ang tao — pagod, stressed, may iniinda, o mababa ang mood — sa halip na bahagi ng pagkatao.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Having a short fuse — little things set you off.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Maikli ang pisi — kahit maliliit na bagay ay nakaiinis.
examples: Snapping at your sibling for a small noise after a long week.
Nasigawan mo ang kapatid dahil sa maliit na ingay matapos ang mahabang linggo.
questions: Is the short fuse new, and what else has been draining you?
Bago ba ang maikling pisi, at ano pa ang umuubos sa iyo?

terms.short_definition: A bright, warm feeling of delight, often sudden, when something good happens.
terms.short_definition_fil: Maliwanag at mainit na pakiramdam ng tuwa, kadalasang biglaan, kapag may magandang nangyari.
terms.detailed_definition: Positive emotions like joy do more than feel nice: research suggests they broaden attention and help people build friendships, skills and resilience over time.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi lang masarap sa pakiramdam ang mga positibong damdamin gaya ng galak: ayon sa pananaliksik, pinalalawak nito ang atensiyon at tumutulong sa pagbuo ng pagkakaibigan, kasanayan at katatagan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: That lift in your chest when something good happens.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang gaan sa dibdib kapag may magandang nangyari.
examples: Laughing until you cry with your cousins at a family reunion.
Tumatawa hanggang maluha kasama ang mga pinsan sa reunion.
questions: What made you smile today, even briefly?
Ano ang nagpangiti sa iyo ngayong araw, kahit sandali?
cues: You described a bright, happy feeling.

terms.short_definition: A core Filipino value: seeing others as part of a shared self, not as strangers. It is the root of pakikiramdam, bayanihan and many Filipino ways of caring.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pangunahing pagpapahalagang Pilipino: pagtingin sa iba bilang kasama sa iisang pagkatao, hindi bilang ibang tao. Ugat ito ng pakikiramdam, bayanihan at maraming paraan ng pagmamalasakit ng Pilipino.
terms.detailed_definition: Sikolohiyang Pilipino, developed by Virgilio Enriquez, describes kapwa as the centre of Filipino social values. It helps explain why support from family, barkada and community matters so much for Filipino mental health.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilalarawan ng Sikolohiyang Pilipino, na pinasimulan ni Virgilio Enriquez, ang kapwa bilang sentro ng mga pagpapahalagang panlipunan ng Pilipino. Ipinaliliwanag nito kung bakit napakahalaga ng suporta ng pamilya, barkada at komunidad sa kalusugang pangkaisipan ng Pilipino.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling that others are part of you, and you of them.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na bahagi mo ang iba, at bahagi ka nila.
examples: Neighbours cooking together for a family who just lost someone.
Nagluluto nang sama-sama ang mga kapitbahay para sa pamilyang namatayan.
questions: Who is kapwa to you?
Sino ang kapwa mo?

terms.short_definition: Doing something good for someone, without expecting anything back.
terms.short_definition_fil: Paggawa ng mabuti para sa iba, nang walang hinihintay na kapalit.
terms.detailed_definition: A review of many studies found that doing acts of kindness gives a small boost to the well-being of the person doing them, as well as helping others.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ayon sa pagsusuri ng maraming pag-aaral, nagbibigay ng maliit na pagtaas sa kagalingan ng gumagawa ang mga gawang kabaitan, bukod sa natutulungan ang iba.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Small good things done for others.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Maliliit na mabuting bagay na ginagawa para sa iba.
examples: Sharing your umbrella with a classmate.
Pinasukob mo ang kaklase sa iyong payong.
questions: What kind act could you do today that would take five minutes?
Anong mabuting gawa ang kaya mong gawin ngayon sa loob ng limang minuto?

terms.short_definition: The painful subjective feeling that your existing social connections do not meet your psychological need for closeness and belonging.
terms.short_definition_fil: Masakit na pakiramdam ng kawalan ng malalim na koneksyon o pag-unawa mula sa ibang tao.
terms.detailed_definition: Loneliness is distinct from being physically alone. One can feel profoundly lonely in a crowded room if there is a perceived lack of meaningful intimacy.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maaari kang makaramdam ng pangungulila kahit napapaligiran ka ng maraming tao kung pakiramdam mo ay walang tunay na nakakakilala sa iyo.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling unseen or emotionally isolated, wishing you had someone who truly understands your inner world.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pangungulila sa taong tunay na makauunawa sa nararamdaman mo nang walang paghuhusga.
examples: Sitting in a bustling classroom in San Fernando yet feeling like an invisible outsider.
Nasa gitna ng masiglang klase o pamilya ngunit pakiramdam mo ay dayuhan ka at nag-iisa.
questions: Do you yearn for deeper emotional intimacy rather than just more people around you?
Naghahanap ka ba ng mas tapat at malalim na pakikipag-usap?

Feeling alone can be loneliness even when people are around.
Feeling unseen by others is a common description of loneliness.

terms.short_definition: Deep affection, care and attachment toward someone.
terms.short_definition_fil: Malalim na pagmamahal, malasakit at pagkakalapit sa isang tao.
terms.detailed_definition: Love takes many forms: family, friends, partners, community. Feeling loved and connected is one of the strongest protective factors for mental health.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maraming anyo ang pagmamahal: pamilya, kaibigan, kapareha, komunidad. Ang pakiramdam na minamahal at may kaugnayan ay isa sa pinakamatibay na proteksiyon sa kalusugang pangkaisipan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Caring about someone so much that their well-being matters to you.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Labis na pagmamalasakit sa isang tao na mahalaga sa iyo ang kapakanan niya.
questions: Who do you feel most cared for by?
Kanino mo pinakanararamdaman na inaalagaan ka?

terms.short_definition: The sense that your life matters and makes sense, often tied to purpose, values and relationships.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam na mahalaga at may saysay ang buhay mo, kadalasang kaugnay ng layunin, pagpapahalaga at relasyon.
terms.detailed_definition: Researchers distinguish having meaning from searching for it. Both are normal; searching is common during change, loss or growing up.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Pinaghihiwalay ng mga mananaliksik ang pagkakaroon ng kahulugan at ang paghahanap nito. Parehong normal; karaniwan ang paghahanap tuwing may pagbabago, pagkawala o paglaki.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling that what you do matters.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na may saysay ang ginagawa mo.
questions: What gives your days a sense of purpose?
Ano ang nagbibigay ng layunin sa mga araw mo?

terms.short_definition: A state of mental well-being that lets people cope with the stresses of life, realise their abilities, learn and work well, and contribute to their community.
terms.short_definition_fil: Kalagayan ng mabuting kalusugan ng isip na tumutulong sa tao na harapin ang mga hamon ng buhay, makita ang sariling kakayahan, matuto at magtrabaho nang maayos, at makapag-ambag sa komunidad.
terms.detailed_definition: Mental health is more than the absence of a mental health condition. Everyone has mental health, and it can shift over time, like physical health. The Philippine Mental Health Act (RA 11036) recognises it as part of the right to health.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Higit pa sa kawalan ng karamdaman ang kalusugang pangkaisipan. Lahat ay may kalusugang pangkaisipan, at nagbabago ito sa paglipas ng panahon, gaya ng kalusugan ng katawan. Kinikilala ito ng Mental Health Act (RA 11036) bilang bahagi ng karapatan sa kalusugan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: How you are doing on the inside: your thoughts, feelings and how you cope.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Kumusta ka sa loob: ang iyong isip, damdamin at paraan ng pagharap.
examples: Noticing you sleep, eat and get along with people better after a calmer month.
Napansin mong mas maayos ang tulog, kain at pakikisama mo matapos ang mas kalmadong buwan.
questions: What helps your mind feel steady?
Ano ang nakatutulong para maging panatag ang isip mo?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: A health condition involving significant changes in thinking, emotion or behaviour that cause distress or make daily life harder.
terms.short_definition_fil: Kondisyong pangkalusugan na may malaking pagbabago sa pag-iisip, damdamin o kilos na nagdudulot ng hirap o nakaaabala sa araw-araw.
terms.detailed_definition: Mental health conditions are common and treatable. Only qualified professionals can diagnose them. Having one is not a weakness or a personal failing, and people with them are entitled to care without discrimination under RA 11036.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Karaniwan at nagagamot ang mga kondisyong pangkaisipan. Mga kuwalipikadong propesyonal lamang ang makapagdi-diagnose nito. Hindi ito kahinaan o personal na pagkukulang, at may karapatan sa pangangalaga nang walang diskriminasyon ang mga may ganito ayon sa RA 11036.
terms.in_simpler_terms: A health problem that affects how you think, feel or act, and can be treated.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Problemang pangkalusugan na nakaaapekto sa pag-iisip, damdamin o kilos, at nagagamot.
questions: Is there someone you trust who could help you find a professional to talk to?
May pinagkakatiwalaan ka bang makatutulong na makahanap ng propesyonal na makakausap?

terms.short_definition: Paying attention to the present moment on purpose, without judging it.
terms.short_definition_fil: Sadyang pagbibigay-pansin sa kasalukuyang sandali nang walang paghuhusga.
terms.detailed_definition: Mindfulness practices are used in several evidence-based approaches. They are a skill to practise, not a cure, and are not suitable for everyone in every moment.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ginagamit ang mga gawaing mindfulness sa ilang batay-sa-ebidensiyang pamamaraan. Kasanayan ito na sinasanay, hindi lunas, at hindi angkop sa lahat sa bawat sandali.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Noticing what is happening right now, gently.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Mahinahong pagpansin sa nangyayari ngayon mismo.
examples: Noticing the warmth of a cup in your hands for a full minute.
Pinansin mo ang init ng tasa sa iyong mga kamay nang isang buong minuto.
questions: What do you notice right now, without changing it?
Ano ang napapansin mo ngayon, nang hindi ito binabago?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

cues: Mindfulness is one way people practise steadying themselves.

terms.short_definition: A longer-lasting background feeling, less intense than an emotion and often without one clear cause.
terms.short_definition_fil: Mas matagal na damdaming nasa likuran, hindi kasing-tindi ng emosyon at kadalasang walang iisang malinaw na sanhi.
terms.detailed_definition: An emotion might last minutes; a mood can colour a whole day or week. Sleep, food, stress and the people around us all shape mood. A low mood that lasts most days for more than two weeks is worth talking to a professional about.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ilang minuto lang maaaring tumagal ang emosyon; ang kalooban ay maaaring kulayan ang buong araw o linggo. Nakaaapekto rito ang tulog, pagkain, stress at mga tao sa paligid. Mainam na ikonsulta sa propesyonal ang mababang kalooban na tumatagal nang halos araw-araw nang higit dalawang linggo.
terms.in_simpler_terms: The general colour of your day.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang pangkalahatang kulay ng araw mo.
examples: Waking up in a heavy mood for no clear reason.
Nagising na mabigat ang kalooban nang walang malinaw na dahilan.
questions: What colour would you give your mood today?
Anong kulay ang ibibigay mo sa kalooban mo ngayon?

terms.short_definition: The drive that gets you started and keeps you going toward something.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang tulak na nagpapasimula at nagpapatuloy sa iyo patungo sa isang bagay.
terms.detailed_definition: Self-determination theory suggests motivation grows when people feel some choice, feel capable, and feel connected to others. Low motivation can be a sign of tiredness or low mood, not laziness.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ayon sa self-determination theory, lumalago ang motibasyon kapag may pagpipilian, pakiramdam na kaya, at koneksiyon sa iba. Ang mababang motibasyon ay maaaring senyales ng pagod o mababang mood, hindi katamaran.
terms.in_simpler_terms: The “why” that gets you moving.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang “bakit” na nagpapakilos sa iyo.
questions: What part of this task do you actually care about?
Anong bahagi ng gawaing ito ang talagang mahalaga sa iyo?

terms.short_definition: A bittersweet longing for past times, places or people.
terms.short_definition_fil: Mapait-tamis na pananabik sa nakaraang panahon, lugar o tao.
terms.detailed_definition: Research suggests nostalgia is mostly a positive, comforting emotion that can boost a sense of connection and meaning, especially when we feel lonely.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ayon sa pananaliksik, kadalasang positibo at nakaaaliw ang pananabik sa nakaraan; napalalakas nito ang pakiramdam ng koneksiyon at kahulugan, lalo na kapag nag-iisa.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Missing the old days, with a smile and a little ache.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Nami-miss ang nakaraan, na may ngiti at kaunting kirot.
examples: Hearing a song from high school and remembering old friends.
Narinig ang kanta noong high school at naalala ang mga dating kaibigan.

terms.short_definition: A general expectation that good things are likely to happen.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pangkalahatang inaasahan na malamang na may magagandang mangyayari.
terms.detailed_definition: Optimism is linked with better coping and health, but it is not forcing yourself to be cheerful. Realistic optimism still sees problems clearly while expecting that they can be handled.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Kaugnay ang pagiging positibo ng mas mabuting pagharap at kalusugan, pero hindi ito pagpipilit na maging masaya. Malinaw pa ring nakikita ng makatotohanang pagiging positibo ang problema habang umaasang kaya itong harapin.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Expecting that things will probably work out.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Inaasahang malamang na magiging maayos ang lahat.
questions: What would a realistic but hopeful view of this situation be?
Ano ang makatotohanan pero may pag-asang pagtingin sa sitwasyong ito?

terms.short_definition: An everyday word for thinking about something so much that it becomes tiring and unhelpful.
terms.short_definition_fil: Karaniwang salita para sa labis na pag-iisip sa isang bagay hanggang sa nakakapagod at hindi na nakatutulong.
terms.detailed_definition: Overthinking is a popular umbrella term. Psychologists usually split it into worry (about the future) and rumination (about the past).
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Popular na pangkalahatang termino ang overthinking. Karaniwang hinahati ito ng mga sikologo sa pag-aalala (tungkol sa hinaharap) at rumination (tungkol sa nakaraan).
terms.in_simpler_terms: Your brain stuck in a loop it cannot get out of.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Naiipit ang isip mo sa ikot na hindi makalabas.
examples: Rereading a message you sent ten times and imagining every way it could be misunderstood.
Sampung beses mong binasa muli ang ipinadalang mensahe at inisip ang bawat paraan na maaari itong mamali ng intindi.
questions: Is the loop about something that might happen, or something that already did?
Tungkol ba ang ikot sa maaaring mangyari, o sa nangyari na?

terms.short_definition: The feeling that the demands placed on you far exceed your immediate capacity to process or manage them.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pakiramdam na sabay-sabay at sobra-sobra ang mga pasanin kumpara sa kaya mong dalhin sa sandaling ito.
terms.detailed_definition: Emotional overwhelm occurs when cognitive and sensory inputs outstrip coping resources, leading to mental freeze, paralysis, or a desire to shut down.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Nangyayari kapag nagpatong-patong ang gawain at alalahanin kaya nahihirapang mag-isip o magdesisyon kung saan magsisimula.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling like everything is happening all at once and your brain cannot find a place to start.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na parang sasabog ang isip mo dahil sa dami ng kailangang asikasuhin nang sabay-sabay.
examples: Staring at a list of five urgent assignments and feeling entirely unable to write even a single word.
Nakatitig sa tambak na school requirements o gawaing-bahay nang hindi malaman kung anong uunahin.
questions: Does breaking down your current situation into one single tiny step bring a slight sense of relief?
Makatutulong ba kung hahatiin mo ang mga gawain sa pinakamaliit na hakbang muna?

A pile-up of tasks is a frequent trigger of overwhelm.

"Hindi ko na kaya" expresses feeling unable to cope with what is in front of you.
Saying there is so much at once often goes with overwhelm.

terms.short_definition: A sudden wave of intense fear that peaks within minutes, with strong physical symptoms such as a pounding heart or shortness of breath.
terms.short_definition_fil: Biglaang matinding takot na umaabot sa rurok sa loob ng ilang minuto, may kasamang malakas na kabog ng dibdib o hirap huminga.
terms.detailed_definition: Panic attacks are very frightening but typically pass. Chest pain or trouble breathing can also have medical causes, so new or severe symptoms should be checked by a health professional. Recurrent attacks are something a professional can help with.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Nakatatakot ang panic attack pero karaniwang lumilipas. Maaari ding may medikal na sanhi ang pananakit ng dibdib o hirap huminga, kaya dapat ipasuri sa health professional ang bago o matinding sintomas. Natutulungan ng propesyonal ang paulit-ulit na atake.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Your body's alarm going off at full volume, all at once.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Sabay-sabay na tumunog nang malakas ang alarma ng katawan mo.
examples: Suddenly feeling your chest tighten and being sure something terrible is happening, then it eases after ten minutes.
Biglang sumikip ang dibdib mo at sigurado kang may masamang nangyayari, saka ito humupa pagkalipas ng sampung minuto.
questions: Did it come on suddenly and peak within a few minutes?
Bigla ba itong dumating at umabot sa rurok sa loob ng ilang minuto?

terms.short_definition: Support offered by someone with similar experiences or in a similar position, such as a fellow student.
terms.short_definition_fil: Suportang ibinibigay ng taong may katulad na karanasan o katayuan, gaya ng kapwa estudyante.
terms.detailed_definition: Peer supporters listen and help people connect to resources. They are not counselors or clinicians and should refer to professionals when needed.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Nakikinig at tumutulong ang mga peer supporter na maiugnay ang tao sa mga serbisyo. Hindi sila counselor o clinician at dapat silang mag-refer sa propesyonal kung kailangan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Someone like you who has been there and can listen.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Isang taong tulad mo na dumaan na rito at handang makinig.
questions: Is there someone in your circle who would listen without judging?
May tao ba sa paligid mo na makikinig nang hindi nanghuhusga?

terms.short_definition: Holding extremely high standards and being very self-critical when they are not met.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagkakaroon ng napakataas na pamantayan at labis na pagpuna sa sarili kapag hindi ito naabot.
terms.detailed_definition: Perfectionism can drive effort, but it is often linked to stress, procrastination and burnout when mistakes feel unacceptable.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maaaring magtulak ng pagsisikap ang perpeksiyonismo, pero madalas itong kaugnay ng stress, pagpapaliban at burnout kapag hindi katanggap-tanggap ang anumang pagkakamali.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling like anything less than perfect is failure.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na kabiguan ang anumang kulang sa perpekto.
examples: Not submitting a project because it is "not good enough yet", even though it is complete.
Hindi mo ipinasa ang proyekto dahil “hindi pa sapat,” kahit tapos na ito.
questions: What would "good enough" look like here?
Ano ang itsura ng “sapat na” dito?
