terms.short_definition: A clinical condition that can develop after a traumatic event, involving re-experiencing, avoidance and a persistent sense of threat.
terms.short_definition_fil: Klinikal na kondisyong maaaring umusbong matapos ang traumatikong pangyayari, kasama ang muling pagdanas, pag-iwas, at patuloy na pakiramdam ng panganib.
terms.detailed_definition: PTSD is diagnosed by qualified professionals using specific criteria. Having difficult memories after an event does not by itself mean PTSD.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Mga kuwalipikadong propesyonal ang nagdi-diagnose ng PTSD gamit ang tiyak na pamantayan. Ang pagkakaroon ng mabibigat na alaala matapos ang isang pangyayari ay hindi nangangahulugang PTSD na.
terms.in_simpler_terms: When the mind keeps reacting as if a past danger is still happening.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Kapag patuloy na tumutugon ang isip na parang nangyayari pa ang dating panganib.
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: A good feeling about something you did or achieved through your own effort.
terms.short_definition_fil: Magandang pakiramdam tungkol sa isang bagay na nagawa o naabot mo sa sariling pagsisikap.
terms.detailed_definition: Research separates authentic pride (“I worked hard for this”) from hubristic pride (“I am better than others”). Authentic pride is linked with self-esteem and motivation.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Pinaghihiwalay ng pananaliksik ang tunay na pagmamalaki (“Pinaghirapan ko ito”) at ang mapagmataas na pagmamalaki (“Mas magaling ako sa iba”). Kaugnay ng pagpapahalaga sa sarili at motibasyon ang tunay na pagmamalaki.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Being glad about what you did, and letting yourself feel it.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Natutuwa sa nagawa mo, at hinahayaang maramdaman ito.
examples: Finishing a hard project and allowing yourself to feel good about it.
Natapos mo ang mahirap na proyekto at hinayaan mong matuwa ka rito.
questions: What is something you did recently that you can be proud of?
Ano ang kamakailang nagawa mo na maipagmamalaki mo?
cues: You described being proud of yourself.

terms.short_definition: Delaying tasks you intend to do, even when you expect the delay to make things worse.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagpapaliban ng mga gawaing balak mong gawin, kahit alam mong mas lalala ang sitwasyon.
terms.detailed_definition: Research often describes procrastination as a way of managing uncomfortable feelings about a task, not simply laziness.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Madalas ilarawan ng pananaliksik ang pagpapaliban bilang paraan ng pag-iwas sa hindi komportableng damdamin tungkol sa gawain, hindi basta katamaran.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Putting it off because starting feels uncomfortable.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ipinagpapaliban dahil hindi komportable ang magsimula.
examples: Cleaning your entire room instead of starting an essay due tomorrow.
Nilinis mo ang buong kuwarto sa halip na simulan ang sanaysay na ipapasa bukas.
questions: What feeling shows up when you think about starting?
Anong damdamin ang lumilitaw kapag iniisip mong magsimula?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

cues: Struggling to start is often what procrastination feels like from inside.

terms.short_definition: A medical doctor who specialises in mental health and can diagnose conditions and prescribe medicine.
terms.short_definition_fil: Doktor na espesyalista sa kalusugang pangkaisipan na nakapagdi-diagnose at nakapagrereseta ng gamot.
terms.detailed_definition: Psychiatrists often work with psychologists and counsellors. In La Union, the Ilocos Training and Regional Medical Center (ITRMC) offers psychiatric consultation.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Madalas makipagtulungan ang mga saykayatrista sa mga sikologo at counselor. Sa La Union, may psychiatric consultation sa Ilocos Training and Regional Medical Center (ITRMC).
terms.in_simpler_terms: A doctor for the mind.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Doktor para sa isip.
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: Humane, practical support for people in distress: looking, listening and linking them to help.
terms.short_definition_fil: Makatao at praktikal na suporta sa taong nababagabag: pagtingin, pakikinig at pag-uugnay sa tulong.
terms.detailed_definition: Described by the World Health Organization as "look, listen, link". It does not require being a professional, and it is not therapy.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilalarawan ito ng World Health Organization bilang “tumingin, makinig, mag-ugnay.” Hindi kailangang propesyonal para magawa ito, at hindi ito therapy.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Basic, caring first steps you can take for someone who is struggling.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Simple at maalagang unang hakbang na magagawa mo para sa taong nahihirapan.

If you want to help someone, psychological first aid describes the first steps.

terms.short_definition: A professional trained in psychology who can assess, support and, if licensed, provide therapy. Psychologists do not prescribe medicine.
terms.short_definition_fil: Propesyonal na sinanay sa sikolohiya na nakapagsusuri, sumusuporta at, kung lisensiyado, nagbibigay ng terapiya. Hindi nagrereseta ng gamot ang sikologo.
terms.detailed_definition: In the Philippines, the practice of psychology is regulated by the Professional Regulation Commission under RA 10029. Psychologists often work in schools, clinics, hospitals and workplaces.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Sa Pilipinas, kinokontrol ng Professional Regulation Commission ang pagsasanay ng sikolohiya ayon sa RA 10029. Madalas magtrabaho ang mga sikologo sa paaralan, klinika, ospital at lugar ng trabaho.
terms.in_simpler_terms: A trained expert in how people think and feel.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Sinanay na eksperto sa pag-iisip at damdamin ng tao.
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
Republic Act No. 10029 — Philippine Psychology Act of 2009
APA Dictionary of Psychology, American Psychological Association

terms.short_definition: Being directed or connected from one source of help to another that is better suited to your needs.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagdirekta o pagkonekta mula sa isang mapagkukunan ng tulong patungo sa mas angkop sa iyong pangangailangan.
terms.detailed_definition: For example, a teacher may refer a student to the guidance office, and a counselor may refer to a doctor or psychologist.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Halimbawa, maaaring i-refer ng guro ang estudyante sa guidance office, at ang counselor naman sa doktor o sikologo.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Being pointed to the right person who can help.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pagtuturo sa tamang taong makatutulong.
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
Psychological first aid: Guide for field workers

terms.short_definition: Being excluded, turned down or not accepted by others, and the hurt that follows.
terms.short_definition_fil: Hindi pagtanggap, pagtanggi o pag-etsapwera ng iba, at ang sakit na kasunod nito.
terms.detailed_definition: Social rejection can hurt in ways that feel physical. The hurt is real even when the rejection was small.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maaaring masaktan ang pagkatanggi ng iba sa paraang parang pisikal. Totoo ang sakit kahit maliit ang pagtanggi.
terms.in_simpler_terms: The sting of not being chosen or wanted.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang hapdi ng hindi mapili o hindi gustuhin.
examples: Seeing photos of a gathering your friends did not invite you to.
Nakita mo ang mga litrato ng salu-salong hindi ka inimbitahan ng mga kaibigan.
questions: Is the hurt about this one moment, or does it echo older moments?
Tungkol ba ang sakit sa sandaling ito lang, o umaalingawngaw ito ng mga dating sandali?

Not being invited can feel like rejection.

terms.short_definition: The easing you feel when something stressful ends or turns out better than feared.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang pagluwag na nararamdaman kapag natapos ang nakaka-stress o mas maganda ang kinalabasan kaysa kinatakutan.
terms.detailed_definition: Relief often shows in the body: a long breath out, loosened shoulders, tears. Noticing it can help you see how much tension you had been carrying.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Madalas makita ang ginhawa sa katawan: mahabang buntong-hininga, lumuwag na balikat, luha. Ang pagpansin dito ay nagpapakita kung gaano kabigat ang dinadala mo.
terms.in_simpler_terms: The breath out after holding it for too long.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang paghinga nang maluwag matapos ang matagal na pagpigil.
examples: Hearing that your test results are fine.
Narinig mong maayos ang resulta ng pagsusuri mo.
questions: What tension did you not notice until it lifted?
Anong bigat ang hindi mo napansin hanggang sa nawala ito?
cues: Sinabi mong gumaan ang loob mo.

terms.short_definition: The process of adapting well and recovering in the face of adversity or stress.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang proseso ng mabuting pag-angkop at pagbangon sa harap ng pagsubok o stress.
terms.detailed_definition: Resilience is not a fixed trait or "being strong". It grows from relationships, support, skills and resources around a person.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi permanenteng katangian o “pagiging malakas” ang katatagan. Lumalago ito mula sa relasyon, suporta, kasanayan at mga mapagkukunan sa paligid ng tao.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Bending without breaking, and finding your way back.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Bumabaluktot pero hindi nababali, at nakababalik.
examples: Struggling after a family move, then slowly finding new routines and friends.
Nahirapan ka matapos lumipat ang pamilya, pagkatapos ay unti-unting nakahanap ng bagong routine at kaibigan.
questions: Who or what has helped you get through hard times before?
Sino o ano ang nakatulong sa iyo na malampasan ang mahihirap na panahon dati?

terms.short_definition: Time to recover energy, through sleep, breaks, or doing something calm and different.
terms.short_definition_fil: Panahon para mabawi ang lakas, sa pamamagitan ng tulog, pahinga, o paggawa ng kalmado at ibang bagay.
terms.detailed_definition: Rest is not laziness. Regular breaks, enough sleep and time away from demands help prevent burnout and protect mental health.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi katamaran ang pahinga. Nakatutulong ang regular na pahinga, sapat na tulog at oras na malayo sa mga hinihingi para maiwasan ang burnout at maprotektahan ang kalusugang pangkaisipan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Letting your battery recharge.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Hinahayaang mag-charge ang baterya mo.
questions: What kind of rest do you need: sleep, quiet, or fun?
Anong klaseng pahinga ang kailangan mo: tulog, katahimikan, o saya?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: Repetitive, unproductive dwelling on the causes and consequences of past distress without taking constructive action.
terms.short_definition_fil: Paulit-ulit na pag-ikot ng isip sa mga nakaraang pagkakamali o suliranin nang walang nalilikhang solusyon.
terms.detailed_definition: Rumination traps the mind in a loop of "Why did this happen to me?" and "What if I failed?", exacerbating anxiety and depressive symptoms.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Pag-ikot ng isip sa nakalipas na kahihiyan o problema, na nagpapatagal lamang sa sama ng loob.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Like a broken record in your head replaying an awkward or painful event over and over.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Parang sirang plaka sa isip na paulit-ulit na nagpapatugtog ng mga alalahanin at pagkakamali.
examples: Lying awake until 3 AM replaying a misunderstanding from two days ago.
Gising hanggang madaling araw kakaisip sa isang nasabing salita sa kaklase noong nakaraang araw.
questions: Is this train of thought helping you find a solution, or simply making you feel heavier?
Nakatutulong ba ang paulit-ulit na pag-iisip, o lalo lang nitong pinapabigat ang loob mo?

terms.short_definition: A natural human emotional response to loss, disappointment, or painful experiences.
terms.short_definition_fil: Normal at makataong damdamin dulot ng pagkabigo, pagkawala, o masakit na karanasan.
terms.detailed_definition: Sadness is transient and adaptive; it allows us to process sorrow and signal our need for support without a complete loss of self-worth or cognitive functioning.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ang kalungkutan ay pansamantala at mahalagang bahagi ng pagkatao; hindi nito ganap na pinapatay ang kakayahang magsaya kapag may magandang nangyari.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling down or crying because something hurt, while still being able to smile at a comforting memory or hug.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pagkalungkot dahil may nangyaring masakit, ngunit kaya pa ring ngumiti o makaramdam ng ginhawa sa yakap ng kaibigan.
examples: Feeling sorrowful for a few days after receiving low marks or saying goodbye to a visiting relative.
Nalulungkot dahil sa mababang marka o pamamaalam sa mahal sa buhay.
questions: Can you still experience moments of warmth, humor, or appetite despite feeling down?
May mga sandali pa rin ba na napapangiti ka o nagugutom kahit nalulungkot ka?

terms.short_definition: Slowing down to fully notice and enjoy a good moment.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagbagal para lubos na mapansin at matamasa ang isang magandang sandali.
terms.detailed_definition: Savoring can be about the past (reminiscing), the present (enjoying now) or the future (looking forward). It is a simple way to make good moments last longer.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maaaring tungkol sa nakaraan (pag-alala), kasalukuyan (pagtamasa ngayon) o hinaharap (pag-aabang) ang pagnamnam. Simpleng paraan ito para mas tumagal ang magagandang sandali.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Letting a good moment sink in.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Hinahayaang tumagos ang magandang sandali.
examples: Eating your favourite merienda slowly, noticing every bite.
Dahan-dahang kinakain ang paboritong meryenda, pinapansin ang bawat kagat.
questions: What small good moment could you slow down for today?
Anong maliit na magandang sandali ang puwede mong pagbagalan ngayon?

terms.short_definition: Accepting all parts of yourself, strengths and flaws, without needing to be perfect.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagtanggap sa lahat ng bahagi ng sarili, lakas at kahinaan, nang hindi kailangang maging perpekto.
terms.detailed_definition: Self-acceptance does not mean giving up on growth. It means your worth does not depend on getting everything right.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi nangangahulugan ang pagtanggap sa sarili na susuko na sa paglago. Ibig sabihin, hindi nakasalalay ang halaga mo sa pagiging tama sa lahat.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Being okay with who you are, as you are.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ayos lang sa iyo kung sino ka, kung ano ka.
questions: What is one thing about yourself you are learning to accept?
Ano ang isang bagay sa sarili mo na natututuhan mong tanggapin?

terms.short_definition: The things you do to look after your own health and well-being, like sleep, food, movement, rest and connection.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang mga ginagawa mo para alagaan ang sariling kalusugan at kagalingan, gaya ng tulog, pagkain, paggalaw, pahinga at pakikipag-ugnayan.
terms.detailed_definition: The World Health Organization describes self-care as what people do to promote their health and cope with illness, with or without a health worker. Self-care supports professional care but does not replace it.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Inilalarawan ng World Health Organization ang pag-aalaga sa sarili bilang ginagawa ng tao para itaguyod ang kalusugan at harapin ang sakit, may health worker man o wala. Sinusuportahan nito ang propesyonal na pangangalaga pero hindi ito pinapalitan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Treating yourself like someone you care about.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pagtrato sa sarili na parang taong mahal mo.
examples: Going to bed on time during exam week.
Natulog sa tamang oras kahit exam week.
questions: What is one small thing your body needs today?
Ano ang isang maliit na kailangan ng katawan mo ngayon?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: Treating yourself with the same kindness, care, and understanding that you would offer to a beloved friend during failure or suffering.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagturing sa sarili nang may lambing, malasakit, at pag-unawa sa halip na malupit na pagpuna kapag nagkakamali.
terms.detailed_definition: Composed of self-kindness versus self-judgment, common humanity versus isolation, and mindfulness versus over-identification with flaws.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Pagtanggap na ang pagkakamali at kahinaan ay normal na bahagi ng pagiging tao, hindi patunay na wala kang kwenta.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Talking to yourself like a caring friend would, especially when you make a mistake.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakikipag-usap sa sarili nang may respeto at malasakit kapag may nasirang plano.
examples: Saying to yourself: 'It makes sense that I made a mistake, I have been under immense pressure,' instead of calling yourself useless.
Pagsasabi sa sarili: 'Tao lang ako, pagod ako ngayon kaya nagkamali ako,' sa halip na laitin ang sarili.
questions: What would you say right now to your closest friend if they were in your exact shoes?
Ano ang sasabihin mo sa matalik mong kaibigan kung siya ang nasa kalagayan mo ngayon?

terms.short_definition: Trusting that you can handle a task or situation.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pagtitiwala na kaya mong harapin ang isang gawain o sitwasyon.
terms.detailed_definition: Confidence usually grows from experience: trying, learning, and seeing that you can cope. It can be strong in one area and low in another.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Kadalasang lumalago ang tiwala sa sarili mula sa karanasan: pagsubok, pagkatuto, at pagkakita na kaya mo. Maaari itong malakas sa isang bahagi at mahina sa iba.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Believing “I can do this.”
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Naniniwalang “Kaya ko ito.”
examples: Volunteering to report in class after practising at home.
Nagboluntaryong mag-report sa klase matapos magsanay sa bahay.
questions: Where do you already feel confident?
Saan ka na may tiwala sa sarili?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

terms.short_definition: How you judge and value yourself overall.
terms.short_definition_fil: Kung paano mo hinuhusgahan at pinahahalagahan ang iyong sarili.
terms.detailed_definition: Low self-esteem often shows up as harsh self-judgement and doubting your worth. Self-compassion is a related but different idea: it is about how you treat yourself, not how you rate yourself.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Madalas lumitaw ang mababang pagpapahalaga sa sarili bilang malupit na paghusga sa sarili at pagdududa sa sariling halaga. Kaugnay pero iba ang malasakit sa sarili: tungkol ito sa pagtrato mo sa sarili, hindi sa pagmamarka sa sarili.
terms.in_simpler_terms: The opinion you hold about yourself.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang opinyon mo tungkol sa sarili mo.
examples: Assuming you will fail before trying something new.
Inaakala mong mabibigo ka bago pa man subukan ang bagong bagay.
questions: Whose voice does your self-judgement sound like?
Kaninong boses ang tunog ng paghusga mo sa sarili?

terms.short_definition: A painful feeling that you are flawed, inadequate or unworthy as a person.
terms.short_definition_fil: Masakit na pakiramdam na may mali, kulang o hindi karapat-dapat sa iyong pagkatao.
terms.detailed_definition: Shame targets the whole self rather than a specific action, which makes it heavier than guilt and more likely to lead to hiding or withdrawing.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Tinatamaan ng hiya ang buong sarili sa halip na isang gawa, kaya mas mabigat ito kaysa pagkakonsensiya at mas malamang na humantong sa pagtatago o pag-iwas. Sa kulturang Pilipino, may mas malawak ding kahulugan ang “hiya” na kaugnay ng pakikitungo sa kapwa.
terms.in_simpler_terms: "I am bad", rather than "I did something bad".
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: “Masama ako,” sa halip na “May nagawa akong masama.”
examples: Wanting to disappear after a mistake, sure that everyone now sees you as worthless.
Gusto mong maglaho matapos magkamali, sigurado kang walang halaga na ang tingin sa iyo ng lahat.
questions: Would you speak to a friend in the same way you are speaking to yourself?
Ganito mo rin ba kakausapin ang isang kaibigan?

terms.short_definition: An objective lack of contact and communication with family, friends, and the wider community.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pisikal at obhetibong kawalan ng pakikipag-ugnayan sa pamilya, kaibigan, o pamayanan.
terms.detailed_definition: Whereas loneliness is subjective distress, isolation is a measurable lack of social ties or interactions, often caused by illness, geographic distance, or withdrawal.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ang pananatili sa loob ng silid nang walang nakakausap na kahit sino sa loob ng maraming araw.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Actually having very few or no people to talk to or spend time with.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Walang makausap o makasama dahil sa layo o sadyang pananatili nang mag-isa.
examples: Remaining inside your bedroom without speaking to family or peers for several days.
Hindi lumalabas ng kwarto at hindi sumasagot sa mga tawag o mensahe sa loob ng mahabang panahon.
questions: Are you physically spending days without speaking to anyone outside?
Ilang araw ka nang hindi nakikipag-usap o nakikisalamuha sa labas ng bahay?

terms.short_definition: Pulling back from people and social activities you would usually take part in.
terms.short_definition_fil: Pag-atras mula sa mga tao at gawaing panlipunan na karaniwan mong sinasalihan.
terms.detailed_definition: Withdrawal is something you do (a behaviour), while loneliness is something you feel. Withdrawal can be a sign that someone is struggling — it is one of the changes the Notice step of helping someone looks for.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ang pag-iwas ay ginagawa (kilos), samantalang ang pag-iisa ay nararamdaman. Maaaring senyales ang pag-iwas na nahihirapan ang tao — isa ito sa mga pagbabagong hinahanap sa hakbang na “Pansinin” sa pagtulong sa iba.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Pulling away from people, even ones you like.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Paglayo sa mga tao, kahit sa mga gusto mo.
examples: Leaving messages unread for days and skipping every invitation.
Ilang araw nang hindi binubuksan ang mga mensahe at tinatanggihan ang bawat imbitasyon.
questions: Is pulling back giving you rest, or keeping you stuck?
Pahinga ba ang naibibigay ng paglayo, o lalo kang naiipit?

terms.short_definition: Negative beliefs, labels or treatment directed at people because of a characteristic such as a mental health condition.
terms.short_definition_fil: Negatibong paniniwala, tatak o pagtrato sa tao dahil sa isang katangian tulad ng kondisyon sa kalusugang pangkaisipan.
terms.detailed_definition: Stigma is one of the main reasons people delay seeking help. Self-stigma happens when people apply those negative beliefs to themselves.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Isa ang stigma sa mga pangunahing dahilan kung bakit naaantala ang paghingi ng tulong. Nangyayari ang self-stigma kapag inilalapat ng tao sa sarili ang mga negatibong paniniwalang ito.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Being judged or labelled for struggling.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Hinuhusgahan o binabansagan dahil nahihirapan.
examples: Not telling anyone you see a counselor because you fear being called "baliw".
Hindi mo sinasabi kahit kanino na nagpapakonsulta ka sa counselor dahil takot kang tawaging “baliw.”
questions: What would make it easier to talk about this where you are?
Ano ang makapagpapadali na pag-usapan ito sa lugar mo?

terms.short_definition: The body and mind's response to demands or pressure.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang tugon ng katawan at isip sa mga hinihingi o presyon.
terms.detailed_definition: Short bursts of stress can help you focus. Stress becomes harmful when it is intense or never lets up, which is described as chronic stress.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Nakatutulong sa pagtuon ang maiikling sandali ng stress. Nagiging mapanganib ito kapag matindi o hindi tumitigil, na tinatawag na matagalang stress.
terms.in_simpler_terms: The feeling of pressure when something is asking a lot of you.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang pakiramdam ng presyon kapag maraming hinihingi sa iyo.
examples: Feeling tense the week before finals, then relieved when they are over.
Tensiyonado ka sa linggo bago ang finals, saka gumaan nang matapos ito.
questions: Is this pressure tied to a specific event that will end?
Nakatali ba ang presyong ito sa isang pangyayaring matatapos din?

terms.short_definition: The people you can turn to for help, comfort or advice.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang mga taong malalapitan mo para sa tulong, aliw o payo.
terms.detailed_definition: A support system can include family, friends, classmates, teachers, faith communities and professionals. Strong social connection is linked with better mental and physical health.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Maaaring kasama sa mga masasandalan ang pamilya, kaibigan, kaklase, guro, komunidad ng pananampalataya at mga propesyonal. Kaugnay ng mas mabuting kalusugan ng isip at katawan ang matibay na ugnayan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: The people who have your back.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Ang mga taong nasa likod mo.
questions: Who are two people you could reach out to this week?
Sino ang dalawang taong malalapitan mo ngayong linggo?

terms.short_definition: A brief reaction to something unexpected, which can turn pleasant or unpleasant.
terms.short_definition_fil: Maikling reaksiyon sa hindi inaasahan, na maaaring maging kaaya-aya o hindi.
terms.detailed_definition: Surprise is one of the emotions studied across many cultures. It is usually short and quickly turns into another feeling, like joy or fear.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Isa ang pagkagulat sa mga damdaming pinag-aaralan sa maraming kultura. Kadalasang maikli ito at mabilis na nagiging ibang damdamin, gaya ng tuwa o takot.
terms.in_simpler_terms: A quick jolt when something unexpected happens.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Biglang kabig kapag may hindi inaasahang nangyari.

terms.short_definition: A natural, short-term reduction in physical or mental energy that reliably resolves after adequate rest or sleep.
terms.short_definition_fil: Normal at panandaliang pagbaba ng lakas na karaniwang nawawala matapos ang maayos na tulog o pamamahinga.
terms.detailed_definition: A benign physiological response to recent physical exertion, late nights, or concentrated cognitive tasks. Core motivation and enjoyment of life remain intact.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Karaniwang tugon ng katawan sa puyat o mabigat na gawain. Nanatili pa rin ang gana sa buhay kapag nakapagpahinga na.
terms.in_simpler_terms: You are physically weary, but sleeping well or taking a quiet day makes you feel like yourself again.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pagod ka lang dahil sa maghapong trabaho o pag-aaral, pero sumisigla ulit pagkatapos ng magandang tulog.
examples: Feeling sleepy after studying late for an exam, but waking up refreshed after an 8-hour sleep.
Inaantok matapos ang pagsusulit, ngunit sumigla muli pagkatapos makabawi ng tulog.
questions: Did you feel better and more optimistic after a good night's sleep or a quiet afternoon?
Bumuti ba ang pakiramdam mo matapos ang isang gabi ng mahimbing na tulog?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino

cues: Tiredness is the everyday word — worth comparing with deeper exhaustion.
Sleepiness after effort is usually short-term tiredness.
"Pagod" is the everyday word for tiredness.
Lack of sleep (puyat) usually causes short-term tiredness.

terms.short_definition: Treatment through talking with a trained professional, to understand and change patterns in thoughts, feelings and behaviour.
terms.short_definition_fil: Paggamot sa pamamagitan ng pakikipag-usap sa sinanay na propesyonal, para maunawaan at mabago ang mga pattern sa isip, damdamin at kilos.
terms.detailed_definition: Therapy can help with many difficulties, not only serious conditions. There are many approaches, such as cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT). In the Philippines, psychologists are licensed under RA 10029.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Makatutulong ang terapiya sa maraming hirap, hindi lang sa malulubhang kondisyon. Maraming pamamaraan, gaya ng cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT). Sa Pilipinas, lisensiyado ang mga sikologo ayon sa RA 10029.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Regular talks with a trained helper to work through things.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Regular na pakikipag-usap sa sinanay na tagatulong para harapin ang mga bagay.
questions: What would you want to work on if you saw a therapist?
Ano ang gusto mong harapin kung makikipag-usap ka sa therapist?

terms.short_definition: The emotional response to a deeply distressing or threatening event, or the event itself.
terms.short_definition_fil: Ang emosyonal na tugon sa isang lubhang nakababahala o mapanganib na pangyayari, o ang pangyayari mismo.
terms.detailed_definition: Not everyone who goes through a terrible event develops lasting difficulties. When reactions persist and disrupt daily life, trauma-informed professionals can help.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi lahat ng dumaan sa kakila-kilabot na pangyayari ay nagkakaroon ng pangmatagalang hirap. Kapag nagpapatuloy at nakaaabala sa araw-araw ang mga reaksiyon, makatutulong ang mga propesyonal na may kaalaman sa trawma.
terms.in_simpler_terms: When something so frightening happens that it keeps affecting you afterwards.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Kapag may nangyaring sobrang nakatatakot na patuloy kang naaapektuhan pagkatapos.
questions: Do you have someone safe you could talk to about what happened?
May ligtas na tao ka bang makakausap tungkol sa nangyari?
sources: Diksiyonaryo.ph — online na diksiyonaryo ng wikang Filipino
cues: Flashbacks can follow traumatic events — a professional can help.
Being unable to put a frightening event behind you can relate to trauma.

terms.short_definition: Feeling good and functioning well: a mix of positive emotions, satisfaction with life, meaning and good relationships.
terms.short_definition_fil: Maayos na pakiramdam at pamumuhay: halo ng magagandang damdamin, kasiyahan sa buhay, kahulugan at mabuting relasyon.
terms.detailed_definition: Well-being is not the same as never feeling bad. People can have good overall well-being and still go through hard days.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Hindi nangangahulugan ang kagalingan na hindi ka na malulungkot. Maaaring maayos ang kabuuang kagalingan kahit may mahihirap na araw.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Feeling okay with your life, overall.
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Pakiramdam na ayos ang buhay mo, sa kabuuan.
examples: A busy week that still felt meaningful because you spent time with people you love.
Abalang linggo na makabuluhan pa rin dahil may oras ka sa mga mahal mo.
questions: What is one thing that adds to your well-being each week?
Ano ang isang bagay na nagdaragdag sa kagalingan mo linggo-linggo?

terms.short_definition: Repeated thoughts about possible problems or bad outcomes in the future.
terms.short_definition_fil: Paulit-ulit na pag-iisip tungkol sa mga posibleng problema o masamang mangyayari.
terms.detailed_definition: Worry is the thinking part of anxiety. It focuses on the future ("what if…"), while rumination tends to replay the past.
terms.detailed_definition_fil: Ang pag-aalala ang bahaging pag-iisip ng pagkabalisa. Nakatuon ito sa hinaharap (“paano kung…”), samantalang ang rumination ay paulit-ulit na binabalikan ang nakaraan.
terms.in_simpler_terms: Your mind running through "what if" after "what if".
terms.in_simpler_terms_fil: Takbo nang takbo ang isip sa “paano kung” pagkatapos ng “paano kung.”
examples: Lying awake thinking about every way tomorrow's exam could go wrong.
Gising ka pa sa gabi at iniisip ang bawat paraan na maaaring magkamali ang exam bukas.
questions: Is your mind looking forward ("what if") or backward ("why did I")?
Pasulong ba ang tingin ng isip mo (“paano kung”) o paatras (“bakit ko ginawa”)?

relationships: Burnout develops over time as a direct consequence of unmanaged chronic stress.
Ang burnout ay nabubuo bunga ng matagalang stress na hindi nabigyan ng lunas o pahinga.
Temporary tiredness recovers with a good sleep; burnout persists even after resting because emotional and motivational reserves are depleted.
Ang pansamantalang pagod ay nawawala sa tulog; ang burnout ay nananatili dahil ubos ang emosyonal na lakas.
Chronic overwhelm frequently precedes burnout as sustained high demands wear down resilience.
Ang patuloy na pagka-overwhelm ang kadalasang nagiging dahilan ng tuluyang burnout.
Sadness is a transient, healthy emotional reaction to pain; depression is an enduring clinical disorder causing persistent numbness, worthlessness, and functional impairment.
Ang kalungkutan ay pansamantalang damdamin; ang depresyon ay mas malalim na medikal na kalagayan na tumatagal ng linggo at pumipigil sa pamumuhay.
Loneliness is the painful subjective ache of feeling disconnected; social isolation is the objective physical absence of social contact.
Ang pangungulila ay damdamin ng kakulangan sa malalim na koneksyon; ang isolation ay pisikal na kawalan ng kasama.
Continually replaying distressing thoughts triggers continuous stress responses in the body.
Ang paulit-ulit na pag-ikot ng negatibong isip ay nagpapanatili ng mataas na stress sa katawan.
Grounding anchors you in the sensory present, directly breaking the mental spiral of rumination.
Ang grounding ay humihila sa iyo pabalik sa kasalukuyan, pumuputol sa paulit-ulit na pag-aalala.
Cultivating self-compassion helps prevent and heal burnout by moderating perfectionism and permitting rest.
Ang malasakit sa sarili ay panangga sa burnout dahil tinutulungan ka nitong magpahinga nang walang kasalanan.
Being overwhelmed again and again, without relief, can wear down emotional energy.
Stress is the response to pressure; overwhelm is the sense that the pressure is more than you can manage right now.
Emotional exhaustion is one of the core parts of burnout, but it can also happen outside work or study.
Tiredness usually lifts with rest; emotional exhaustion tends to stay even after a break.
Burnout comes from prolonged demands in general; compassion fatigue comes specifically from caring for people who are suffering.
People with compassion fatigue often describe deep emotional exhaustion.
"Drained" is the everyday word; emotional exhaustion is the term used when it is deep and lasting.
Feeling drained after one hard day is usually temporary tiredness.
Worry is the thinking side of anxiety; anxiety also includes body sensations and feelings of fear.
Anxiety is a common human emotion. GAD is a clinical condition diagnosed by professionals when worry is excessive and long-lasting.
A panic attack is a sudden, intense surge of fear; anxiety is usually a longer, lower-level state.
Worry looks ahead ("what if"), while rumination looks back ("why did I").
"Overthinking" is the everyday umbrella; worry is the future-focused kind.
"Overthinking" is the everyday umbrella; rumination is the past-focused kind.
Stress can be short and pass once the demand ends; chronic stress continues for months.
Stress is a response to a current pressure; anxiety can continue even when no clear pressure is present.
Sadness is part of grief, but grief also includes longing, anger, guilt and numbness.
Grief usually comes in waves tied to the loss and still allows moments of warmth; depression is a clinical condition with more pervasive changes.
Guilt says "I did something bad"; shame says "I am bad".
Self-compassion is often described as an antidote to shame.
Frustration is a kind of anger focused on obstacles and blocked goals.
Anger is a response to a specific event; irritability is a lowered threshold that makes small things provoke annoyance.
Emptiness and loneliness often appear together, but emptiness can be felt even with good company.
Both describe a muted inner life; emptiness feels like something missing, numbness like feelings turned down.
Numbness is sometimes part of a wider dissociative experience after overwhelming stress.
Irritability is frequently reported by people who are burned out or very stressed.
Helplessness is "I can't change this"; hopelessness is "this will never get better".
Discouragement is tied to a specific goal or setback; hopelessness is a broader belief about the future.
If hopelessness comes with thoughts of not wanting to live, crisis lines can help right away.
Procrastination usually involves caring about the task but avoiding it; apathy means not caring.
Apathy is a lack of interest or drive; anhedonia is a clinical term for reduced ability to feel pleasure.
Losing interest and engagement is common in burnout.
Repeated setbacks can make starting the next task feel pointless.
Agency is the sense that your actions make a difference — the opposite of helplessness.
Anhedonia is one of the features professionals look for when assessing depression.
Self-esteem is how you rate yourself; self-compassion is how you treat yourself, especially when you struggle.
Insecurity in a specific area often reflects lower self-esteem there.
Self-compassion offers a kinder voice than the inner critic.
A harsh inner critic can feed feelings of shame.
People with impostor feelings often hold perfectionistic standards.
Fear of not doing something perfectly can make it hard to start.
Never-ending high standards can add to prolonged stress and burnout.
Experiences of rejection can deepen loneliness.
Belonging is the felt sense of connection that loneliness lacks.
Withdrawal is something you do (pulling back); loneliness is something you feel.
Pulling away from people over time can lead to social isolation.
Trauma refers to a distressing event and its impact; PTSD is a specific clinical condition only some people develop.
Dissociation can be one of the ways the mind responds to traumatic experiences.
Resilience describes adapting and recovering; burnout describes depletion when demands outstrip recovery.
Peer support can lower the barrier that stigma creates around asking for help.
Grounding techniques are commonly used to reconnect with the present during dissociation.
Mindfulness brings attention to the present, while rumination keeps attention in the past.
Grounding is a quick, concrete form of present-moment attention.
Distress tolerance is about surviving a crisis moment; regulation is the broader skill of influencing emotions.
Distress tolerance is a personal skill; crisis intervention is help from another person or service.
Peer supporters listen and connect you to help; counselors are trained professionals.
Counselors may refer to doctors, psychologists or psychiatrists when needed.
PFA is basic humane support anyone can give; crisis intervention is urgent help from trained services.
Peer supporters often use psychological first aid principles: look, listen, link.
Sadness is an active feeling of sorrow; emptiness feels like an absence of feeling.
Joy is a burst of delight; happiness is the broader sense that life is going well.
Biglaang tuwa ang galak; ang kaligayahan ay mas malawak na pakiramdam na maayos ang buhay.
Contentment often comes with a calm body and mind.
Kadalasang may kasamang kalmadong katawan at isip ang kapanatagan.
Regularly noticing what you are thankful for is linked with small gains in well-being.
Kaugnay ng maliit na pagbuti ng kagalingan ang regular na pagpansin sa ipinagpapasalamat.
Hope sees a way forward; hopelessness feels like the future is closed.
Nakakakita ng daan ang pag-asa; sa kawalan ng pag-asa, parang sarado ang kinabukasan.
Optimism expects good outcomes; hope adds the paths and the will to reach them.
Umaasa sa magandang resulta ang pagiging positibo; dinaragdagan ito ng pag-asa ng daan at kagustuhang maabot ito.
Calm settles the body; anxiety keeps it on alert.
Pinapanatag ng kahinahunan ang katawan; pinananatili itong alerto ng pagkabalisa.
Grounding is one way to guide yourself back to calm.
Isang paraan ang grounding para bumalik sa kahinahunan.
Relief is the easing that comes when a stressor ends.
Ang ginhawa ay ang pagluwag kapag natapos ang pinagmumulan ng stress.
Healthy pride feels good about what you did; shame feels bad about who you are.
Natutuwa sa nagawa ang malusog na pagmamalaki; masama ang pakiramdam sa sarili ang hiya.
Self-compassion is compassion turned toward yourself.
Ang malasakit sa sarili ay habag na ibinabaling sa sarili.
Caring for suffering for a long time without rest can lead to compassion fatigue.
Ang matagal na pagmamalasakit nang walang pahinga ay maaaring humantong sa pagkapagod sa pagmamalasakit.
Kindness is compassion put into action.
Ang kabaitan ay habag na isinasagawa.
Both bring a racing heart and butterflies; excitement looks forward to something good.
Parehong may mabilis na tibok ng puso at kiliti sa tiyan; may inaabangang maganda ang pananabik.
Awe and joy are both positive emotions; awe comes from something vast.
Parehong positibong damdamin ang pagkamangha at galak; nagmumula ang pagkamangha sa isang napakalawak na bagay.
Flow is full absorption; boredom is struggling to engage at all.
Lubos na pagkalubog ang flow; ang pagkabagot ay hirap na maging abala.
Motivation is the drive to act; apathy is a loss of caring and drive.
Tulak para kumilos ang motibasyon; pagkawala ng pakialam at sigla ang kawalang-bahala.
A sense of meaning fills what emptiness feels like is missing.
Pinupuno ng kahulugan ang tila nawawala sa kahungkagan.
Savoring uses mindful attention to stay with good moments.
Gumagamit ang pagnamnam ng mapanuring kamalayan para manatili sa magagandang sandali.
Both treat yourself kindly; self-acceptance focuses on accepting who you are.
Parehong mabait sa sarili; nakatuon ang pagtanggap sa sarili sa pagtanggap kung sino ka.
Confidence trusts your ability; insecurity doubts it.
Nagtitiwala sa kakayahan ang tiwala sa sarili; pinagdududahan ito ng kawalan ng kumpiyansa.
In boredom you want to engage but can’t; in apathy the wanting itself fades.
Sa pagkabagot, gusto mong maging abala pero hindi magawa; sa kawalang-bahala, nawawala ang mismong pagnanais.
Nostalgia often shows up when we feel lonely, and can bring comfort.
Madalas lumitaw ang pananabik sa nakaraan kapag nag-iisa, at maaari itong magbigay-aliw.
Ambivalence is feeling more than one emotion about the same thing.
Ang halo-halong damdamin ay pagkakaroon ng higit sa isang emosyon sa iisang bagay.
Mindfulness invites curiosity about what you notice, instead of judgement.
Inaanyayahan ng mindfulness ang pagkamausisa sa napapansin, sa halip na paghusga.
Accepting what can’t be changed right now is part of getting through distress.
Bahagi ng pagtitiis sa matinding damdamin ang pagtanggap sa hindi pa mababago ngayon.
Regulating emotions is one kind of coping.
Isang uri ng pagharap sa hirap ang pamamahala sa damdamin.
Rest is one of the most basic forms of self-care.
Isa ang pahinga sa pinakapangunahing anyo ng pag-aalaga sa sarili.
Regular rest helps prevent burnout, though burnout itself needs more than a weekend off.
Nakatutulong ang regular na pahinga para maiwasan ang burnout, pero higit pa sa isang weekend ang kailangan ng burnout mismo.
Peer supporters can be part of your support system.
Maaaring bahagi ng mga masasandalan mo ang mga peer supporter.
A support system is the connection that loneliness feels is missing.
Ang mga masasandalan ang koneksiyong tila nawawala sa pangungulila.
Both involve talking with a trained professional; therapy is often longer and goes deeper into patterns.
Parehong pakikipag-usap sa sinanay na propesyonal; kadalasang mas matagal at mas malalim sa mga pattern ang terapiya.
Madalas magbigay ng terapiya ang mga lisensiyadong sikologo.
A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who can prescribe medicine; a psychologist is not.
Doktor na nakapagrereseta ng gamot ang saykayatrista; hindi ganoon ang sikologo.
Good mental health is a key part of overall well-being.
Mahalagang bahagi ng kabuuang kagalingan ang mabuting kalusugang pangkaisipan.
Everyone has mental health; a mental health condition is a specific health problem that can be treated.
Lahat ay may kalusugang pangkaisipan; ang kondisyong pangkaisipan ay tiyak na problemang pangkalusugan na nagagamot.
Stigma about mental health conditions often stops people from seeking help.
Madalas pumipigil sa paghingi ng tulong ang stigma tungkol sa mga kondisyong pangkaisipan.
Kapwa is a Filipino way of experiencing belonging: others are part of a shared self.
Ang kapwa ay paraang Pilipino ng pagkakabilang: bahagi ng iisang pagkatao ang iba.
Empathy feels with someone; compassion adds the wish to help.
Nakikiramdam ang empatiya; dinaragdagan ito ng habag ng kagustuhang tumulong.
Pakikiramdam grows out of seeing others as kapwa.
Lumalago ang pakikiramdam mula sa pagtingin sa iba bilang kapwa.
An emotion is short and has a clear cause; a mood lasts longer and is more in the background.
Maikli at may malinaw na sanhi ang emosyon; mas matagal at nasa likuran ang kalooban.
Happiness is one part of well-being, alongside meaning and good relationships.
Bahagi ng kagalingan ang kaligayahan, kasama ng kahulugan at mabuting relasyon.
Feeling loved helps meet the basic need to belong.
Natutugunan ng pakiramdam na minamahal ang pangunahing pangangailangang mapabilang.
Joy and sadness are opposite poles, and both are normal parts of life.
Magkasalungat ang galak at kalungkutan, at parehong normal na bahagi ng buhay.
